relations.to: Confluence chore: the menial task that sits where every flow of the domain crosses, prep in a kitchen, retracting in surgery, document review in a lawsuit, on-call in a service, obituaries in a newsroom, teaches the domain's traffic in one shift because everything passes through it; the key is the task's position in the flow, not its lowliness, which is what it adds to low-chair-advantages, and it is held only by the stranger who enters as hands, since a patient or a litigant is never handed the retractor; it opens the wrong door where the chore has been outsourced or automated off the confluence, contract dishwashers, e-discovery, so the stranger who takes it learns the outsourced thing and nothing else.
relations.label: If the stranger enters by the peer question, then the confluence chore is closed to them in the same room wherever the chore marks rank, since a visiting partner is not handed document review, and the two entrances are a fork chosen by the first sentence; where the chore is itself the domain's tell, as with the stage in a kitchen, the peer is put on prep precisely to be watched, and the fork closes into one door.

relations.from: Founding wreck: a domain's rules are fossils of its failures, and the failure everyone can name, the bridge that galloped, the wrong-patient transfusion, the fund solvent on paper and dead on cash, is the key to which rules are load-bearing, since a rule with a wreck behind it is broken at one's peril and a rule without one is a habit; not the fatal class, since a wreck can stand behind a rule that guards a recoverable error; it opens the wrong door where the famous wreck is the domain's legend, a business-school case, and the shaping failures are hidden, classified, settled under seal, or filtered by survival, so the stranger reads the failure the domain wants seen.
relations.to: Fatal class: every domain sorts its errors into a small class that cannot be undone and a large class that can, the missed filing deadline, the wrong-side operation, the jibe in a following sea, the dropped table, and a stranger can act at all only once they hold the short list, because slowness buys something only against the fatal class and native speed elsewhere looks reckless until the list is known; not the domain's famous failure but the shape of its error space; it opens the wrong door where the fatal class is unmarked because the domain is young enough that natives have not met it, or where the list is kept deliberately vague to keep juniors slow everywhere.
relations.label: If the founding wreck was of the fatal class, then the rulebook is a fair map of the fatal list; if the wreck guarded a recoverable error, the rulebook overstates the fatal class and the stranger who reads the list off the rules is slow everywhere.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a stranger gain working competence in an unfamiliar important domain fast, and which of those keys transfer between domains while which must be re-found every time?
exploration.changed_question: Which keys does the domain hand to strangers and which must be taken against it, and what does a handed key do to the one who holds it? Breath one treated every key as something a stranger picks up from a domain indifferent to being entered; sharpening Read sheet against the patient leaflet showed that domains hand strangers keys, that the handed key is stable, teachable, and unsaid by natives, and that the tell which catches the holder is fluency in it. A second change came from writing the failure clause of each item: the same mechanism appeared every time, a value carried across a slot, which turned the transfer question into the seriation axis.
exploration.new_member: Tourist key: a domain that must face many strangers manufactures a stranger-facing simplification that is stable, teachable, and false, the patient leaflet, the introductory course, the public standards page, the price list, and the stranger who learns it becomes fluent at the wrong level, since natives never say it and the tell that catches them is their fluency in it; observed as far as the unsaid simplification, speculative in the clause that natives make it because they cannot name their own keys; it opens the wrong door wherever it is offered, which is its point, and the right door only where no natives remain, a dead language, a defunct exchange's rulebook, and the tourist key is all that is left.

priorities.why: It is the cheapest key to test from outside and the edge that hangs on it (the routing question is the hinge said aloud) would, if it holds, make the hardest key on the map reachable through the easiest one.
priorities.next_question: Call the main line of three institutions you do not know (a county court, a hospital, a university department), ask only who would know who handles a stated problem, and write down the question each chair asks before routing; check whether that question is the domain's hinge distinction. If it is in two of three, the edge holds; if the chairs route without asking, the edge is cut.

priorities.item: Tourist key: a domain that must face many strangers manufactures a stranger-facing simplification that is stable, teachable, and false, the patient leaflet, the introductory course, the public standards page, the price list, and the stranger who learns it becomes fluent at the wrong level, since natives never say it and the tell that catches them is their fluency in it; observed as far as the unsaid simplification, speculative in the clause that natives make it because they cannot name their own keys; it opens the wrong door wherever it is offered, which is its point, and the right door only where no natives remain, a dead language, a defunct exchange's rulebook, and the tourist key is all that is left.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that the speculative clause survives, since natives may withhold their keys on purpose rather than by incapacity, but high generative promise: it asks whether every institution that faces strangers must build a false surface, and whether the surface can be dated by which tell it lacks.
priorities.next_question: Take one domain's stranger-facing document (a patient leaflet, an introductory syllabus) and one week of native talk (a ward round, a lab meeting); count how many of the leaflet's distinctions natives ever utter. If the count is near zero, the leaflet is a tourist key; then ask a native to correct it and record whether they can, which separates a decoy kept on purpose from one made by natives who cannot see their own keys.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted with repairs after finding two strangers (client and hands) under one item type, correcting False friend list's total-reversal claim, conditioning the Peer question/Confluence chore fork on whether the chore is the domain's tell, and cutting the Native unit → Native tolerance edge so the loop the form claims can be drawn as Kept tell → Tourist key, and re-cutting the seriation's middle tiers by whether a key is usable before its local value is known (Read sheet beside Native gripe, Confluence chore into the value-first tier).

neighbors.separating_case: A trading desk's rule against Friday deploys, born from an outage rolled back by Monday: a wreck stands behind the rule, so Founding wreck reads it as load-bearing and the stranger obeys it; but the error was recoverable, so Fatal class says slowness there buys little, and the stranger who reads the fatal list off the rulebook is slow everywhere. The converse separates them again: a young domain with a fatal error nobody has yet met holds a fatal class by reasoning and has no wreck at all.

checks.boundary_case: A mentor, the master who takes you on, is out: tempting because it is the fastest entry there is, but a mentor is a source of keys rather than a key and cannot be held in one move. Switchboard chair is in on exactly that contrast, since a person can be a key when the stranger's one use of them is a routing rather than instruction.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: Peer question and Confluence chore sit far apart on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the two entrances are incompatible in one person in one room wherever the chore marks rank, chosen by the first sentence, and that the fork closes into one door where the chore is itself the domain's tell. It shows a loop the line cannot express, now drawn as edges, Prey question → Tourist key → Kept tell → Tourist key, where the domain's decoy and the domain's tell chase each other and the stranger who entered by the outcome question circles one level below the natives. It shows two dependencies into Hinge distinction: from Switchboard chair, a passage from a person to a distinction where the routing question is the hinge said aloud, and from False friend list, where a carried word shifts or reverses the first cut. And Founding wreck → Fatal class states a conditional the adjacency hides: the wreck is a fair map of the fatal list only when the wreck itself was fatal.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context (2026-09-07), not a self-read: the critic found the target preserved, with every item naming a real key and a real wrong door, and admitted the map with repairs rather than a rewrite; the strange members (a question kept in order not to be asked, a decoy the domain manufactures, a tell the domain re-cuts when copied, a gripe read as the negative of a control surface) were kept as mechanisms, and the critic's own boundary ruling, that native costume is out because it opens doors without orienting, sharpened the item type to a thing that changes what the stranger can see rather than what the domain lets in. The one fault the critic left standing in the type, that 'a stranger' covers two (the client and the hands) and the one-move clause fails for half the ring from the client side, is made visible in Confluence chore and carried as the seed.

name: importance-detectors
of: A mechanism by which a stranger reads what a domain actually treats as mattering, off a cost the domain pays or a thing it forgoes rather than a claim it makes, named with the carrier read, one case where it read correctly, the theater or omission by which it lies, and the residence it needs to run: an afternoon outside from documents, a shift of watching, a stress event that must occur, years of repeated shocks, or the failure itself.
items: Underwriter's question: the questions on an insurance application are the map of an outsider who loses money when wrong, so the form tells a stranger what has produced paid claims in enterprises of this kind before anyone inside will, the law firm's application asking about calendaring and conflict checks and never about legal skill, the restaurant's about the fryer and the floor, the trucker's about hours behind the wheel; it reads correctly wherever the insurer has paid claims in this domain for decades, and it reads what hurts the domain rather than what the domain treats as mattering, so the gap between the form's questions and the domain's own drills and locks is itself a reading, the firm with no calendaring system that the form asks about twice; it lies by omission, since the insurer maps only what is frequent, measurable, litigable, and uncorrelated, so the founder's death, the reputation, the partner who walks with the clients, and the technology going obsolete are missing not because they matter less but because nobody will write the policy; the one detector runnable without entering the building.

Two-hand rule: what the domain will not let one person do alone, the two nurses at the narcotics cabinet, the two signatures on the wire, the two keys, the two people counting sponges, marks what it trusts no single one of its own with, which is importance read as distrust; it reads correctly where the rule is the domain's own, as the surgical count is; it lies where an outside judge imposed the rule for legibility, so the dual control exists on paper and the second signer signs from a pile without reading, and the tell of the lie is that the second hand never once refuses; readable in an afternoon from the procedures manual, which is exactly the version most likely to have been imposed.

Costly spare: what the domain keeps a duplicate of at a price, the hospital generator tested weekly, the second engine, the second data feed, the sous-chef who can run the pass, marks what it cannot be without for an hour; not cheap redundancy, spare keyboards in a drawer, which marks nothing because sparing was free; it reads correctly where the spare is expensive and idle; it lies where the redundancy is a fossil kept from a failure the domain no longer has, the diesel generator behind a shop that moved to the cloud, or where a regulator required it; ask what has a spare and the answer arrives the same afternoon, then ask when it was last tested to catch the fossil.

Costly precision: within one domain the quantity measured most finely at the greatest expense is where the money or the danger lives, the pharmacist's milligram, the airline's seat, the jeweler's hundredth of a carat, the foundry's degree at the pour; not domain-entry-keys' native tolerance, which marks a domain against other domains, but the comparison of quantities inside one; it lies where precision follows measurability rather than importance, since a web analytics stack logs clicks to the millisecond because logging is free while whether anyone bought is measured monthly and badly, so every precision must be weighted by what it costs to maintain; it lies again where the precision is the judge's, the refinery's parts per million of sulphur measured to the limit the fuel regulation names and no finer, so a precision that stops exactly at a published limit reads the regulator; and it lies as precision theater, the forecast to three decimals; an afternoon in the domain's own reports, if the cost of measuring can be learned and the limit it stops at can be looked up.

Not on the menu: what the domain refuses to let its paying client choose marks what it holds itself responsible for, as against what it merely serves, the kitchen that substitutes any side but will not serve the chicken rare, the lawyer who lets the client pick the strategy but will not put a lie before the court, the architect who lets the client pick the tile and not the beam; it reads correctly where the refusal costs the domain the sale; it lies where the refusal is liability rather than load, the chicken not served rare because of the lawsuit, and where it is turf, the refusal that protects the profession's fee; ask what one cannot order and a stranger has it in an afternoon, but the reason given will be the judge's, not the domain's.

First look: what the veteran checks first on arriving, before greeting anyone, the sailor going below to look at the bilge, the ICU nurse at the airway, the landlord at the roof, the sysadmin at the disk, the baker at the oven, is the failure that would make every other thing moot; not domain-entry-keys' kept tell, which separates the expert from the imitation, since the first look ranks the domain's failures rather than its people; it reads correctly where several veterans of different training look at the same thing first; it lies where the first look is one veteran's scar, the thing that once burned this person and no one else, or a ritual kept after the risk was engineered away, the driver who still pumps the pedal on a fuel-injected engine; one shift of watching, but at least two veterans.

Tempo drop: the place where a domain leaves its native speed marks what it will not risk at speed, the fast kitchen that goes slow on the allergy ticket, the trading desk that walks the manual settlement, the pit crew that torques the lug nuts by hand, and the inverse in slow domains, the court that moves in a day for an injunction; it reads correctly where the slowness is the veteran's and not the institution's; it lies where slowness is red tape or incompetence, since a bureaucracy is slow everywhere and marks nothing by it, and where the fast case is the theater, the domain that performs an emergency to look serious; one shift, watching the veteran's hands rather than the queue.

Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; aviation's sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken, is the one register drop written into a manual, and the regulator wrote it after wrecks, so it is the afternoon-readable fossil of this detector rather than its living form, which no manual lists; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; and it lies where the tone drops only while rank is in the room, which is deference and not load, the tell being whether the register holds after the powerful leave; a shift in the room, not a document.

Rule the king keeps: a rule the powerful obey in front of the powerless is load-bearing and a rule only the powerless obey is discipline, the chief surgeon scrubbing to the elbow, the captain buckling in, the managing partner running conflicts on her own client, the head of the lab keeping her own notebook; it reads correctly where obedience costs the powerful time or face; it lies where the powerful perform compliance for an audience, the chief executive's ostentatious badge swipe on the day of the audit, and where a load-bearing rule is one the powerful genuinely skip, the surgeon who talks through the time-out, which is not a failure of the detector but a reading that the institution's stated importance and its real one have parted; a few days, since one must see the powerful when they think the rule is optional.

Preemption order: when two things collide, what yields tells what outranks what, the code call that empties a hospital meeting, the customer outage that cancels board preparation, the calving that ends the farmer's dinner, and a domain's night call rule is this order written down, what the attending is woken for, what the chief executive is called about on holiday; it reads correctly when the preempting thing is the same for every rank; it lies where a culture of manufactured fire drills has made everything urgent, so cancellation carries no information, and where what cancels is a person's rank rather than the stakes, so the order maps the hierarchy and not the load; the written list is an afternoon's ask and reads the judge's version, the observed order needs a collision, and collisions come when they come.

Failed drill: what the domain rehearses failing at, the code drill, the disaster recovery test, the mock trial, the dress rehearsal, marks what it believes it will one day face and cannot afford to face untrained; the discriminator is whether the drill can be failed, since a drill that is scored and sometimes fails is a rehearsal and a drill nobody fails is a ceremony, the office fire drill walked with coffee in hand; it reads correctly where the domain wrote its own drill and keeps the scores; it lies where an insurer or a code required the drill and the domain runs it to produce the record; one cycle of the drill, and the score sheet rather than the drill itself.

Halting absence: whose sick day stops the line marks the dependency the domain has never bought a spare for, the one clerk who knows the billing system, the one machinist who can run the old lathe, and the leave calendar carries the same reading, since the two people never allowed the same week off are the two the domain cannot be without; it reads correctly where the halt is in the work and not in the signatures; it lies where the absence halts work because only the absent one may sign, a bottleneck of authority rather than a load, and where the indispensable person has made herself so by hoarding, what status-conversions calls immunity by entanglement, so the halt marks a hostage rather than a load; the calendar is an afternoon's read, the halt itself needs someone to fall ill.

Panic price: what the domain pays any price for when short, the locum at triple rate, the part flown in, the plumber on Christmas, the spot-chartered ship, marks a dependency the budget never shows because at budget time the thing was cheap; it reads correctly where the panic recurs across years and the price is paid without argument; it lies as a one-time panic from bad planning of a thing that did not matter, the toner sent by courier, and it hides where the domain has grown ashamed of its panics and books them under another name; readable from the invoices of a bad month, which a stranger is not shown, and not from the budget, which the stranger is.

Firing offense: what a domain dismisses a person for on the first occurrence, the trader who moves money without the second sign, the researcher who alters a notebook, the cook who plates the allergen, the bartender who drinks on shift, marks the trust the whole domain rests on; not domain-entry-keys' fatal class, which sorts errors by whether they can be undone, since the two diverge and the divergence is the reading, the reversible offense that gets one fired, a leaked memo, and the irreversible one forgiven, the surgeon's honest complication, showing what the institution protects beyond its work, its secrecy or its liability; it lies as a zero-tolerance policy never once enforced; one occurrence, or the peer question of what got the last person fired.

Last cut: in a downturn the line cut last marks what the domain believes it is, the law firm that cut associates and then staff before it touched the partners' draw and thereby confessed to being a partnership before it was a practice, the software firm that cut sales before support and confessed to being its installed base; it reads correctly across several rounds of cuts, since a single round cuts what is easiest; it lies where the protected line is protected by a contract, a pension, a lease, or a patron rather than a load, the newspaper that cut the newsroom before the presses and the trucks, which reads as a confession of being a distribution business only once one has asked whether the presses were under a union contract and the trucks under a lease, so the reading must be corrected by asking who could have cut the protected line and did not; it needs a downturn, which is years, and a stranger who arrives in good times is shown the budget and never the order of cuts.

Reorg survivor: every new chief reorganizes, and what survives three reorganizations unmoved is load-bearing, the mainframe that runs the settlement, the dispatch desk, the one committee nobody abolished; it adds to ghost-leverages, which names the obsolete power that persists by habit, the reading rule over successive shocks that separates the load from the habit; it reads correctly where the survivor was inspected each time and left; it lies where the survivor was invisible, nobody remembered to cut it, or feared, nobody understood it, and fear and invisibility both look like load from outside, so the correction is whether anyone can say what would break; years, and a stranger cannot run it except by reading a history of org charts that nobody keeps.

Fudged figure: the number the domain massages marks what its judge weighs and the domain does not, since nobody fudges a figure nobody reads, the hospital's wait time gamed by relabeling the corridor, the school's test scores, the sales pipeline inflated before the quarterly review; the fudge is a cost paid and a risk run, so it is a detector rather than theater, but a detector of a gap, reading the judge's importance on one side and the domain's contempt for it on the other; it lies where the fudge is vanity rather than defense, the headcount inflated for the founder's pride; from inside it takes years, since one quarter's number is a number, but wherever the judge publishes the line and the domain publishes the distribution, the pile-up just on the good side of the line, the waits that end at three hours fifty-nine, the grades that cluster one mark above the pass, is an afternoon's histogram from outside, so the judge who makes the target legible makes the fudge legible with it.

Unmarked default: the most important thing in a domain may have no word, no drill, no lock, and no line in the budget because it has never been absent, the fish's water, the sailor's boat not sinking, the founder still coming in, the grid still up, and it is detectable only at failure, when the beached fish discovers water and, speculatively, the domain coins the word, writes the drill, and buys the spare within the season; it reads correctly in retrospect and never in advance, which is its whole limit; it lies where the unmarked thing is merely uninteresting rather than assumed, and only the removal tells the two apart; runnable from nowhere and at no time, except the stranger's one move, to ask a native what has never gone wrong, which natives answer with whatever they have never thought about.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: underwriting forms, narcotics cabinets, sterile cockpits, leave calendars, order of cuts, gamed wait times; drawn from medicine, aviation, kitchens, law, trading, farming, and the running of firms.
source.mode: Observed illustrative cases with analytical reading rules, each case simplified to one mechanism; the general claim that afternoon legibility was built for an outside judge is analytical, and Unmarked default's within-the-season clause is speculative and marked.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real read of a domain runs several detectors and corrects each by the others, and the list claims no coverage of every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much residence a detector needs, not a ranking of reliability or value, and the residence times (an afternoon, a shift, an event, years) are authored orders of magnitude rather than measurements; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the sterile cockpit, the newspaper's presses, gamed wait times, narcotics cabinets, the fuel-injected pedal) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about particular institutions or histories.

The claim that what is legible in an afternoon was made legible for an outside judge is analytical and general; Underwriter's question is the named exception, an outsider who pays for being wrong, and there may be others; Unmarked default's clause that a failed default is named, drilled, and spared within the season is speculative and marked as such.

Claims a domain makes about itself (mission statements, org charts, stated priorities, documentation) are outside, as are detectors of status rather than load; where status and load coincide the map reads only the load.

seriation.axis: How much residence a detector needs to run: from a form read outside the building in an afternoon (the underwriter's questions, the dual-control list, what has a spare, what is measured finely, what cannot be ordered), through a shift of watching the veteran (first look, tempo, register, the rule the king keeps), through a stress event that must occur before the detector reads at all (a collision, a drill, an absence, a shortage, a dismissal), through repeated shocks over years (the order of cuts, the reorg survivor, the fudged figure), to the one detector that runs only at failure and never in advance (the unmarked default).
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of reliability or a measurement of time. Underwriter's question opens it because a stranger can run it without entering the building; Unmarked default closes it because it runs only when the thing fails, by which time the stranger is a native. The hinge is Not on the menu → First look, the last detector a stranger can run by asking and the first that must be watched: the asked detector answers in the judge's reason, the chicken not served rare because of the lawsuit, while the watched one cannot be performed for a stranger, since the veteran going below to the bilge does not know she is being read. That adjacency carries the map's central claim, that the afternoon end reads what the domain does for its judges and the years end reads what it does for itself, so legibility and reliability pull apart along the route. A second adjacency, Firing offense → Last cut, marks the passage from a single event to a series: one dismissal reads the trust, and only several rounds of cuts read the identity, since a single round cuts what is easiest. Residence means time and access together, and two items are where they part: Panic price is an afternoon of time but needs the invoices a stranger is not shown, and Fudged figure is years from inside but an afternoon from outside wherever the judge publishes the line and the domain publishes the distribution, since the pile-up just on the good side of the line is a histogram; that exception is a second instance of the cycle, the judge who makes the target legible making the fudge legible with it.

relations.from: Underwriter's question: the questions on an insurance application are the map of an outsider who loses money when wrong, so the form tells a stranger what has produced paid claims in enterprises of this kind before anyone inside will, the law firm's application asking about calendaring and conflict checks and never about legal skill, the restaurant's about the fryer and the floor, the trucker's about hours behind the wheel; it reads correctly wherever the insurer has paid claims in this domain for decades, and it reads what hurts the domain rather than what the domain treats as mattering, so the gap between the form's questions and the domain's own drills and locks is itself a reading, the firm with no calendaring system that the form asks about twice; it lies by omission, since the insurer maps only what is frequent, measurable, litigable, and uncorrelated, so the founder's death, the reputation, the partner who walks with the clients, and the technology going obsolete are missing not because they matter less but because nobody will write the policy; the one detector runnable without entering the building.

relations.label: If the insurer requires dual control as a condition of cover, the two-hand rule is the underwriter's map read twice and the two detectors give one reading, not two; the two-hand rules that add information are the ones no policy asked for.

relations.to: Costly precision: within one domain the quantity measured most finely at the greatest expense is where the money or the danger lives, the pharmacist's milligram, the airline's seat, the jeweler's hundredth of a carat, the foundry's degree at the pour; not domain-entry-keys' native tolerance, which marks a domain against other domains, but the comparison of quantities inside one; it lies where precision follows measurability rather than importance, since a web analytics stack logs clicks to the millisecond because logging is free while whether anyone bought is measured monthly and badly, so every precision must be weighted by what it costs to maintain; it lies again where the precision is the judge's, the refinery's parts per million of sulphur measured to the limit the fuel regulation names and no finer, so a precision that stops exactly at a published limit reads the regulator; and it lies as precision theater, the forecast to three decimals; an afternoon in the domain's own reports, if the cost of measuring can be learned and the limit it stops at can be looked up.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms can someone tell what actually matters inside a domain they do not know, as opposed to what the domain says matters, and which of those detectors can be run from outside in an afternoon while which run only from inside over years?
exploration.changed_question: Who imposed the cost the detector reads? Breath one took every detector to read a cost the domain pays and every lie to be a cheap imitation of that cost. Writing the lie clause of each item produced the same lie every time: an outside judge, an insurer, a regulator, a court, a board, imposed the cost, and the domain pays it to be seen paying. This turned the afternoon-versus-years question inside out, since what a stranger can read in an afternoon is exactly what was made legible for an outside judge, so legibility and reliability pull apart, and the surviving afternoon detectors are those where the outsider loses money when wrong. It also turned theater from noise into signal: the cost of faking a figure is a cost too, and what it reads is the judge.
exploration.new_member: Fudged figure: the number the domain massages marks what its judge weighs and the domain does not, since nobody fudges a figure nobody reads, the hospital's wait time gamed by relabeling the corridor, the school's test scores, the sales pipeline inflated before the quarterly review; the fudge is a cost paid and a risk run, so it is a detector rather than theater, but a detector of a gap, reading the judge's importance on one side and the domain's contempt for it on the other; it lies where the fudge is vanity rather than defense, the headcount inflated for the founder's pride; from inside it takes years, since one quarter's number is a number, but wherever the judge publishes the line and the domain publishes the distribution, the pile-up just on the good side of the line, the waits that end at three hours fifty-nine, the grades that cluster one mark above the pass, is an afternoon's histogram from outside, so the judge who makes the target legible makes the fudge legible with it.

priorities.item: Failed drill: what the domain rehearses failing at, the code drill, the disaster recovery test, the mock trial, the dress rehearsal, marks what it believes it will one day face and cannot afford to face untrained; the discriminator is whether the drill can be failed, since a drill that is scored and sometimes fails is a rehearsal and a drill nobody fails is a ceremony, the office fire drill walked with coffee in hand; it reads correctly where the domain wrote its own drill and keeps the scores; it lies where an insurer or a code required the drill and the domain runs it to produce the record; one cycle of the drill, and the score sheet rather than the drill itself.
priorities.why: The drill is the one detector whose lie is written into its own records, since a score sheet either contains a failure or does not; it can be checked against the judge question without entering the domain's politics, and it is the near end of the map's central cycle.
priorities.next_question: Take one institution's drill records for a year, a hospital's code drills or a firm's recovery tests, and sort the drills by whether any run was ever scored as failed; then sort the same drills by whether an outside body required them; the prediction is that self-written drills sometimes fail and imposed drills never do, and a self-written drill that has never failed is the finding worth a second afternoon.

priorities.item: Unmarked default: the most important thing in a domain may have no word, no drill, no lock, and no line in the budget because it has never been absent, the fish's water, the sailor's boat not sinking, the founder still coming in, the grid still up, and it is detectable only at failure, when the beached fish discovers water and, speculatively, the domain coins the word, writes the drill, and buys the spare within the season; it reads correctly in retrospect and never in advance, which is its whole limit; it lies where the unmarked thing is merely uninteresting rather than assumed, and only the removal tells the two apart; runnable from nowhere and at no time, except the stranger's one move, to ask a native what has never gone wrong, which natives answer with whatever they have never thought about.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it can be run in advance at all, high generative promise: if any move surfaces the unmarked default before failure, the map's far end folds back to its near end without the wreck that usually drives it, and that would be a detector no document, drill, or ledger can give.
priorities.next_question: Ask ten veterans of one domain, separately, what has never gone wrong here, and check the answers against the domain's glossary, drill list, and dual-control list; anything several veterans name that is absent from all three lists is a candidate unmarked default, and the experiment is whether any stranger could have produced that list from any document the domain keeps.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items whose showcase cases sat in the map's own judge column (the sterile cockpit, the refinery's sulphur, the newspaper's presses, the underwriter's 'what kills', the fudge's residence) and relabeling four edges so the cycle admits imported fossils, the precision fork survives an honest audit, and the register discriminator survives rank; no item cut.

neighbors.left: Tempo drop: the place where a domain leaves its native speed marks what it will not risk at speed, the fast kitchen that goes slow on the allergy ticket, the trading desk that walks the manual settlement, the pit crew that torques the lug nuts by hand, and the inverse in slow domains, the court that moves in a day for an injunction; it reads correctly where the slowness is the veteran's and not the institution's; it lies where slowness is red tape or incompetence, since a bureaucracy is slow everywhere and marks nothing by it, and where the fast case is the theater, the domain that performs an emergency to look serious; one shift, watching the veteran's hands rather than the queue.
neighbors.right: Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; aviation's sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken, is the one register drop written into a manual, and the regulator wrote it after wrecks, so it is the afternoon-readable fossil of this detector rather than its living form, which no manual lists; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; and it lies where the tone drops only while rank is in the room, which is deference and not load, the tell being whether the register holds after the powerful leave; a shift in the room, not a document.
neighbors.separating_case: The trading floor at the close: the tempo rises rather than drops while the register goes formal and silent, so the register detector fires and the tempo detector reads nothing. The emergency ward at three in the morning: tempo up and the jokes at their hardest, so the register detector fires only through its gallows inversion while tempo again reads nothing. The two agree on the surgical count, slow and silent, which is why they look like one detector, and part everywhere else; the sterile cockpit is a register rule and not a tempo rule, since it governs what may be spoken and says nothing about how fast the crew works, while the speed of the aircraft below ten thousand feet is capped by a different rule entirely.

checks.boundary_case: The documented procedure and the stated priority list are out: writing is a claim, cheap to produce, and it marks what the domain expects to be asked about later rather than what it treats as mattering. Firing offense is in on exactly that contrast, since dismissing a person is a cost paid, and the tell is that a domain with a written zero-tolerance policy and no dismissals has a document and no detector.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a passage between levels the itinerary conceals: Unmarked default → Failed drill, where a default that fails once is named, drilled, and given a second signature within the season, so every afternoon detector is the fossil of a years-detector that failed, here or in the domain the judge was watching when the rule was written, and the axis is not a line but a cycle that failure drives from its far end back to its near end, with the judge as the path by which another domain's wreck enters it. It shows a fork at Fudged figure → Costly precision: a finely measured quantity is for the judge if it is also the fudged one, the domain's own if it is measured as finely where no report is filed, and the judge's under a real audit if it is honest but stops exactly at the report's limit, and the precision reading alone cannot tell the three apart. It shows an incompatibility at Failed drill → Firing offense: where failing the drill is a firing offense the drill cannot be failed and becomes a ceremony, so one institution cannot run both detectors at full strength on the same thing. And it shows a dependency that collapses two readings into one at Underwriter's question → Two-hand rule, where dual control required as a condition of cover is the insurer's map read twice.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context, who tried to collapse neighbors and to admit a nonmember (biggest budget line) and could do neither: each item names a distinct carrier read, a case where it reads correctly, and a lie with its own shape; the strange members (a fudge read as a signal of the judge, an importance with no name, a drill whose value is that it can be failed, a rule read off who obeys it) survive as mechanisms, and the five repairs re-sort showcase cases into the map's own judge column rather than softening any mechanism.

name: register-jumps
of: A mechanism by which a live situation is moved from one register to another, a register being the rules for who may speak, what counts as a move, and what closes the matter, named with the carrier of the jump (a word, a room, a document, a witness, a delay, a body, a question), what the new register can do that the old could not, what is lost in transit, and whose hand the carrier is in: the weaker party's alone, the weaker party's to propose and the room's to complete, an institution's to lend, or the room-holder's only.
items: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since almost no room may continue its business past an unattended body, and the few that try are the wild priority's quarry; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.

Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy computed to the claim, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted, so where it is paid at all it is paid as reparation for a class rather than damages for a wrong; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.

Get back to you: a live negotiation becomes an asynchronous one when the weaker party leaves with the offer, as a patient tells the surgeon 'I'll think about it' or a candidate takes the offer letter home; the new register admits consultation, writing, and a second reader, and strips the room of the advantage its holder had from being present, at the cost of the offer that expires at the door and the momentum a live yes would have carried; not the statutory cooling-off period, which is a delay granted, but a delay taken, and the holder's 'I need an answer now' is the tell that the room was the holder's whole edge.

Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.

The room's laugh: a claim becomes survivable when it is delivered as a joke and the room laughs, as a junior surgeon's 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' says what a memo could not; the new register lets the unsayable be said in the presence of the party it is about and cannot be answered as a claim, since whoever answers becomes the one who could not take a joke, and what is lost is the remedy, because a joker who later presses the claim seems to renege on the laugh; not low-chair-advantages' Fool's license, which is a standing discount on a chair, but a discount applied to one sentence and paid for by the room, so the jump is proposed by the weaker party and completed by the room, and a joke nobody laughs at lands as a claim, and a worse one; 'only joking' runs the same carrier backward after the room has answered.

If you were my mother: a medical question becomes a family one when kinship is put into the sentence, as a patient asks the oncologist 'what would you do if it were your mother,' and the oncologist, who may not choose for a patient, may choose for a mother; the new register permits a recommendation with a person behind it, and what is lost is the denominator, since the mother has no survival curve, and the patient's authorship of the choice, which the kin register quietly takes over; not the employer's 'we're a family here,' which moves a relation rather than a question and imports unbounded obligation into a contract, and a jump the patient can ask for but only the clinician can complete, since the answer is the register.

In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes when either party writes, so the weaker party can make it alone with the confirming email, 'to summarize what you told me today', which dares the holder to deny the record in writing or let silence stand as assent; 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form only while nothing is yet written, and the holder's second refusal, the written denial, is itself a record.

Bring a friend: a conversation becomes a proceeding when a third body enters the room, as an employee brings a steward to a meeting the manager called a chat, or a child's presence turns a parents' quarrel into a performance for the child; the new register makes every sentence testimony, so offers that could not be repeated are not made and pressure that needs privacy stops, and what is lost is candor and the off-the-record settlement privacy allowed; not a witness kept for later proof, which is In writing's work, but a change in what can be said now, and the inverse jump, switching to a language the third body cannot follow, restores the private register without anyone leaving.

Duel's seconds: a quarrel becomes a ceremony when both parties accept seconds, as the code duello gave the challenged party the choice of weapons and the whole affair a field, an hour, a count, and a sentence that ends it, 'honor is satisfied'; the new register has a terminus, which a fight does not, and hands the challenged party options the fight would never give, and what is lost is winning, since the form fixes much of the outcome before anyone arrives, and the grievance, which the ceremony consumes without addressing; not sport, which is entered for its own sake, but a proceeding entered to end something, and a jump neither party can make alone, since one second is a witness and two are a rule.

Wallet away: a purchase becomes a gift when payment is refused, as a mechanic waves off the bill for a neighbor's brake job; the new register opens a relation the paid bill would have closed, since a gift has no paper that says settled and therefore no end, and what is lost is the price, which told both parties what the work was worth, and the payer's freedom to leave square, since the only way to close a gift is to insult it; the reverse of what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor, adding the door that opens, and a jump only the party owed can make, since a payment forced past a refusal is read as rejecting the relation the refusal offered.

Let the number say it: a contested decision becomes a measurement when someone proposes a test, as an engineer answers an executive's design preference with 'let's A/B it'; the new register settles the matter without a loser, since the number decided, and moves the decision into the room the proposer holds, and what is lost is everything the metric does not measure and the vote of anyone who cannot read the number; not evidence brought to a decision, which stays in the decisional register, but the replacement of the decision by a reading, and a low-chair jump only where the low chair owns the instrument.

Grievance stamp: a hurt becomes a case when the contract's word for it is applied, as a steward tells a worker 'that's not a complaint, that's a grievance' and the matter acquires a form, a deadline, a ladder of steps, and a list of remedies; the new register can be filed, timed, escalated, and won by someone who could not win the argument, and what does not survive transit is the hurt, which no step addresses, and the worker's own voice, which now speaks through the steward; not a renaming for effect, since the word works only where a clause already says what it triggers, so the weaker party can make this jump exactly where someone stronger once wrote it in.

Call the police: a family or commercial dispute becomes a crime when a report is filed, as a bookkeeper's unrepaid loan becomes embezzlement on a police form; the new register brings in a party neither side controls, one that can jail and that no longer needs the complainant's consent, and what is lost is control, since in many jurisdictions the complainant cannot drop what the state has picked up, and the money, which criminal courts restore badly; the heaviest jump the weaker party can make alone and the one that cannot be walked back, unlike the letterhead, which prices every move but leaves the complainant holding the case.

Written for the future court: a lost argument becomes an open one when the loser writes to a reader who is not in the room, as a judge's dissent addresses a court that does not yet exist and a fired officer's memorandum to file addresses an inquiry that may never be held; the new register cannot be answered by the present majority, since its addressee is absent, and what is lost is any effect now and often the loser's standing in the room, where they are seen to have stopped arguing with it; not Told, not claimed, which stays in the room and asks for sympathy, but the one jump reserved to the party who has already lost, and it works only where an archive outlives the room.

Whose desk: a failure with a mechanism becomes a failure with an owner when the room asks who owned it, as a postmortem on a race condition ends with a name and a reorganization; the new register can close today, since a person can be assigned where a mechanism cannot, and what is lost is the mechanism, which recurs under the new owner; not the request for a decision, which moves a question from fact to choice, but a move from cause to person, made by whoever holds the meeting, and run backward by the engineer who answers a staffing question with 'we need a tool.'

Policy says: a personal refusal becomes a categorical one when the manual is produced, as the clerk who cannot say no to a face says 'the policy doesn't allow it'; the new register refuses without insult and applies to everyone equally, and what is lost is the exception, the discretion that could have helped, and the human read of the case; a jump only the holder of the manual can make, and the weaker party's return move, 'let me speak to someone who can decide,' works only where a chair of discretion still exists above the manual, which the manual is often written to abolish.

Feelings clinic: a claim becomes a feeling when it is received as one, as a manager answers 'the schedule is unsafe' with 'I hear that you're feeling stressed'; the new register cannot be wrong and cannot bind, so the room is safe and nothing follows from it, and what is lost is the claim's purchase on the world and the standing of the claimant, who has become a patient; not the diagnosis, which moves an act into pathology, can confine without trial, and can be invoked by the accused as well, but a jump the room-holder makes on the claimant's sentence, and the claimant's counter, restating the feeling as a number or a document, is Let the number say it or In writing entered from below.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: stewards and grievance clauses, tenants asking for email, police reports, seconds and the code duello, dissents and memoranda to file, waved-off bills, traffic stops, ward-round jokes, oncology consultations; drawn from labor, law, medicine, family, engineering, and trade.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism; every item is analytical about a recognizable practice, with no claim about the specific histories named, and no item rests on a single field study since One-way fine was cut at review as a restatement of what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real situation usually undergoes several jumps at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every register or every carrier.
The seriation is an itinerary of whose hand the carrier is in, not a ranking of power, cost, or how often each jump is made; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the code duello, the traffic-stop question, the judicial dissent, the steward's grievance, the tenant's request for an email) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.

Jumps inside one register (forum shopping, escalation from one court to another, a change of room without a change of rules) are outside, and so are reframings and metaphors that describe a situation differently without changing who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter.

Whether 'register' is one thing across law, medicine, family, work, and trade, or only a family of resemblances, the map does not settle; it stipulates a register as a set of rules for speakers, moves, and closes, and every item is read against that stipulation.

seriation.axis: Whose hand the carrier is in: from carriers the weaker party owns outright and no room can confiscate (a body, a first person, a calendar, a question the holder is bound to answer), through carriers the weaker party can bring but the room must complete (a laugh, a kinship sentence, a written reply, a third body, a second), through carriers lent by a counterparty or an institution (the party owed, the instrument, the contract clause, the state, the archive), to carriers only the holder of the room owns (the meeting's question, the manual, the received feeling).
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of power or a count of how often each jump is made. Collapse in the dock opens it because nothing can be taken from a body except by force; Feelings clinic closes it because a reception is the one carrier on the map the weaker party cannot even propose, so the walk runs from the carrier no permission can deny to the carrier nothing can be handed to. In writing sits at the boundary of the first two tiers: the weaker party can make the record alone with a confirming email, and what the room controls is the record's later weight, not its existence. The hinge is Bring a friend → Duel's seconds: one body brought into the room turns talk into testimony, and two bodies who confer on terms turn testimony into a rule, so the witness jump passes into the ceremonial one without anyone intending a ceremony, and the weaker party's carrier (a friend) becomes an institution's (a code). A second adjacency teaches from the far end: Call the police and Written for the future court are the two jumps addressed to a party not in the room, the state now and the archive later, and the first takes the case away while the second leaves the loser holding it. The three room-holder jumps that close the walk share a shape the walk conceals: each moves the matter without anyone saying which register it is now in, which is why Am I being detained? sits near the start as their counter. One-way fine was cut at review as a restatement of what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor, and its seat was wrong on the map's own terms, since a fee set by the party owed is the same hand as Wallet away's waived bill.

exploration.first_question: What carries a situation from one register to another, what can the new register do that the old could not, and what is lost in transit?
exploration.changed_question: Whose hand is the carrier in, and which jumps force the holder to declare a register rather than offer one? Breath one wrote every jump as a move anyone in the situation could make; writing the discriminators showed that most weaker-party jumps are proposals the room completes (the joke needs the laugh, the kinship question needs the clinician to answer as kin, the friend must be admitted to the room), and that the room-holder's jumps are mostly refusals to declare (the manual, the received feeling, the meeting's question move the matter without naming where it went).

priorities.item: Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.
priorities.why: It is the only weaker-party jump on the map that works by making the holder pay, and its reach is stated as exactly the reach of the rule that binds the holder to answer, which is a claim an operator can check against records rather than argue about.
priorities.next_question: Collect twenty recorded encounters in which the weaker party asked which register they were in (traffic stops, workplace 'is that an order', clinic 'is this required'), and for each note whether the holder answered with a declaration, with a manual, or with silence, and whether a rule binding them to answer existed; the map predicts declaration only where the rule exists and the manual as the standard escape everywhere else.

priorities.item: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since almost no room may continue its business past an unattended body, and the few that try are the wild priority's quarry; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; the one register entrance no permission can deny to the weakest party, and unlike the fire alarm, which anyone may pull and which a fine guards, this one is guarded by the discount every later collapse suffers.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that any room has fully abolished the body's override, high generative promise: the emergency register is entered from below by a body and from above by a declaration, and finding rooms that have ruled the bottom door shut would show what a register must pay to have only one door.
priorities.next_question: Find three rooms that have written the collapse out, the exam that continues past a fainting candidate, the chamber that votes over the member carried out, the trading floor that keeps the book open through a heart attack, and write for each what the room pays to keep its register, who is allowed to leave to tend the body, and whether the body's override returns the moment a second body fails.
