neighbors.separating_case: A nurse tells the ward round 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' and nobody laughs; the sentence is now a claim, and a worse one than a memo, and the nurse is exposed. Had she said 'the last field I saw like that was on my first ward, and we lost the patient', nobody needs to laugh: the story stands without the room's help. The joke is completed by the room and the story by its teller, which is why the story sits below the joke on the itinerary although both are the weaker party's, and why a joker's fallback is a story and not a claim.

checks.boundary_case: Reframing in the consultant's sense is out: calling a layoff 'a transition' changes the vocabulary and nothing about who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter, so the layoff proceeds in the same register under a new name. Grievance stamp is in on exactly that contrast, since the word 'grievance' triggers a clause and a clause changes the moves; a word with no clause behind it is a metaphor, and metaphors are not jumps.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals: Whose desk and Let the number say it sit far apart on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the staffing read and the measurement read chase one bug around, each re-registering the other's residue. It shows a fork at Am I being detained? → Policy says: the forcing question has two exits, a declaration the holder must own or a manual that refuses to declare, and the sequence shows only the first. It shows a passage between levels at Bring a friend → Duel's seconds, where a witness becomes a second and a friend becomes a code. And it shows a degradation at Call the police → Written for the future court, where the present-tense jump to the state, if refused, becomes the future-tense jump to the archive while the civil rung stays open beside it. The incompatibility once claimed at Wallet away → One-way fine went with the cut item; it was the admitted Invoice that ends the favor's claim, not this map's.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context: the item type is real, the two forcing questions (Am I being detained?, In writing) each succeed where the other fails, the two holder refusals (Policy says, Feelings clinic) separate on whether the holder is bound, and the loop, the fork, and the passage survived a search for counter-cases; One-way fine was cut as a restatement of an admitted item, In writing's hand claim was corrected, and two universals were softened, while the strange members (a body as the one entrance no permission can deny, a question that makes the holder pay for ambiguity, a dissent addressed to a court that does not exist, a reception nothing can be handed to) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about choosing one's frame.

name: tollgates-that-must-buy
of: A mechanism by which a party holding a chokepoint is nonetheless compelled, by its position as gate, to buy from whoever can read the compulsion, usually the passers themselves and sometimes the suppliers of what the gate must have to remain a gate, named with why the gate must buy, the carrier that holds the clock, what a seller who sees the compulsion can extract, and how the compulsion lapses, since the clock may be held by a higher gate, by the passers, or by the gate's own ledger, tenure, mandate, or habit.
items: Must-take by writ: a higher gate orders the gate to buy from a class, as the Sherman Silver Purchase Act made the Treasury take four and a half million ounces a month from the western mines, PURPA made every utility buy a qualifying facility's power at the utility's own avoided cost, and the renewable fuel standard makes refiners buy ethanol or the credits that stand for it; the carrier is the statute, the seller extracts the fixed price or the credit market the writ creates, and the compulsion lapses only by repeal, which the sellers' own extraction hastens, since the silver purchases drained the gold that made the writ intolerable in 1893; not a subsidy paid by the higher gate, since here the higher gate spends the lower gate's money.

Tenure by consumption: the gate keeps its gate only while it uses it, so it must buy a use, as the airline flies near-empty planes to keep a slot under the eighty-percent rule, the spectrum licensee builds out towers by the license's construction deadline or forfeits the band, and the designated market maker buys at its bid in a falling market because standing ready to buy is the condition of the seat; the carrier is the condition written into the tenure, the seller extracts by supplying the use, the codeshare partner and the discounted passenger, the tower contractor who reads the buildout date, the seller hitting the bid, and the compulsion lapses when the condition is waived, as slot rules were in 2020, or reaches the escape written into it, since the market maker's duty ends at the widest permitted quote and the trading halt; the western farmer who floods a field to keep a water right that lapses with non-use is the limit where the gate buys the use from no one and nothing is extracted, so it sits at the edge of the type rather than inside it; not deal-flow-attractors' counterparty of last resort, whose always is chosen and priced by the node, since here the always is rent on the seat and its ceiling is written by the landlord.

Queue with an exit: the port must clear the ships at anchor because demurrage runs on hulls that belong to others and those hulls can steam to Savannah, so the gate buys longshore overtime at the union's night rate and the union prices the anchorage; the carrier is the passers' own clock together with their alternative, the seller extracts the surcharge and the schedule, and the compulsion inverts the moment the exit closes, since a captive queue costs the gate nothing and becomes its rent, which is why the only hospital in the county clears nothing faster; not velocity-bottlenecks, which are about what a queue does to the flow, since here the question is whom the queue is expensive for.

Crown at the auction: the sovereign that taxes and coins must still roll its debt on the day it matures, so the gate of money buys money from the dealers at whatever the auction says, as Charles V bought the imperial election with Fugger loans and the gilt market removed a British prime minister inside seven weeks; the carrier is the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote and cannot move, the seller extracts yield and, past yield, policy, and the compulsion lapses only into a primary surplus, which buys the money from the taxpayers instead, or into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which moves the price from the dealers to the currency's holders and is paid in inflation when and only when they decide it is, so the escape is the borrower's own mint and that door is priced by a different crowd; not ordinary borrowing, since here the buyer of last resort and the borrower are one body with two names.

Hour that must be manned: a licensed gate must be open at every hour its license names, so it buys whoever can be present at three in the morning at that hour's price, as the hospital pays the agency nurse three times the day rate and the school pays the substitute on the first morning of term; the carrier is the license and the patient who might arrive, the seller extracts the differential of the instant rather than of the skill, and the compulsion lapses at dawn, when a float pool is built, or when the state caps the agency rate, as Massachusetts did; not deal-flow-attractors' awake at the hour, which is the searcher's horizon collapsing to whoever answers, since here the gate is obliged to be the one that answers and must buy the answering.

Answer that may not be withheld: a court may not decline to decide a case properly before it, so the litigant who hands it the more adoptable answer sells the court its opinion, as trial judges sign proposed findings of fact verbatim and appellate opinions lift whole paragraphs from the winning brief; the carrier is the prohibition of non liquet together with the docket, the seller extracts the rule in its own words, and the compulsion lapses at the jurisdictional door, since dismissal for want of standing is the one way to answer without buying either story, and it thins toward the top, where a court that may deny review without reasons is under no compulsion at all; not persuasion-moves' shifting of a belief, since the court must take one of the two stories whether or not either persuades.

No that must be written: when a gate's refusal requires a written reason and its acceptance requires none, the gate leans toward buying, so the applicant extracts the stamp by exhausting the writer, as patent continuations are refiled until an examiner's rejections cost more than an allowance, while at the consulate, where the refusal needs a sentence and the visa needs a file, the same asymmetry leans the other way; the carrier is the paperwork asymmetry, the seller extracts persistence priced in the examiner's hours, and the compulsion lapses when the gate's own reviewer starts counting bad yeses, as after a recalled drug; not the answer that may not be withheld, which forbids silence and leans neither way, since a jury must return and owes reasons for neither verdict.

Borrowed eyes: a gate that must decide on evidence it cannot make buys its sight from the party it is gating, as the drug regulator judges trials the sponsor designed and ran, the auditor relies on management's representations, and the rating agency rates from the issuer's numbers on the issuer's fee; the carrier is the missing witness architecture, the seller extracts the frame, the endpoints, the comparator, the definition of done, and the compulsion lapses only when someone builds the gate its own eyes, as a university laboratory rather than the regulator caught the diesel defeat device; not capture, which is a purchased gatekeeper, since this gate is honest and blind and buys what it must in order to see at all.

Powder that must be lit: money committed for a purpose on a clock must be spent on that purpose before the clock runs, so the fund in the last year of its investment period is a forced buyer of whatever is for sale, and founders who know the vintage raise from it, as the private foundation must pay out five percent each year or pay excise on the shortfall and grantees call in December; the carrier is the investment period in the partnership agreement or the payout rule in the statute, the seller extracts price and terms in proportion to the calendar, and the compulsion lapses at the period's end, after which the fund cannot buy at all, so the compulsion is a step that becomes a wall; not runway-illusions, which are about the operator's own time, since here the clock is on the buyer and the seller reads it.

Shelf bought first: a two-sided gate must buy the side whose absence the other side can see, so the platform pays for content before it has viewers, as the new console pays for exclusives, the streaming service commissions originals to open, and the marketplace seeds sellers with fee holidays; the carrier is the visibility of the empty side, the seller of the first shelf extracts a launch fee that the thousandth seller cannot, and the compulsion lapses at thickness, when any one item on the shelf becomes replaceable and the fee goes to zero; not deal-flow-attractors' shelf that draws both sides, which is what a full shelf does to what arrives, since here the question is what the gate must pay to fill it and which side it must fill first.

Papered house: when the crowd is the evidence, the gate buys the crowd, as the theatre gives away the first week's seats so critics see a full house and actors play to one, the conference comps the front rows, and the tuition-dependent college discounts the freshman class until the dormitory is full; the carrier is the reviewer who counts heads, the seller extracts a free seat or a merit scholarship whose merit is the calendar, since aid rises after the first of May, and the compulsion lapses when the reviews are in or the class is full; not shelf bought first, which buys supply so that buyers come, since here the gate buys buyers so that suppliers, critics, and other buyers come, and the two together form a fork over which side to buy; not what-a-price-does' price for the stranger's eyes, where the recorded number is the evidence and the gate buys the number, since here the bodies are the evidence and the price is spent down to zero to get them.

News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick; not the stamp with an expiry, which can print no award and leave the year empty, since the hole can only be substituted and never left empty, so a stamp whose format fixes the count, the forty under forty, is a hole wearing a stamp and decays by dilution rather than by under-lending.

Built to be bought: a gate whose franchise is worth more than any single bypass must buy each credible bypass it cannot copy, at the bypass's price, so a bypass is built to be sold to the gate it threatens, as the photo app with no revenue sold for a billion to the network it would have drained; the carrier is the franchise value and the gate's ability to see the bypass coming, the seller extracts a price set by the gate's loss rather than the bypass's earnings, and the compulsion lapses when the bypasses become a class too numerous to buy, when a higher gate forbids the purchase, or when the gate can copy the bypass faster than the bypass can grow, as the network copied the ephemeral story it had failed to buy, so the extraction is capped at the lesser of the gate's loss and the gate's cost to copy, and a bypass built to be sold must be one the gate cannot clone; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is the mover's move, since here it is the gate's compulsion and the builder's plan.

Vehicle that must move: when one bill must pass by a date or the gate's own lights go out, every member may attach a rider, so the compelled passage becomes a vehicle for purchases nobody is compelled to make, as the appropriations deadline carries provisions that could never pass alone; the carrier is the deadline plus the shutdown's cost, the seller extracts the rider and the leadership extracts by rationing rider slots, and the compulsion lapses when the deadline is survived, as in 2013, which revealed the must to be a may with a price, so that what lapsed was the date and not the eventual purchase; not coalition-frictions' holdout, which is the pivotal member's leverage on any vote, since here the leverage exists only on the vehicle that must move.

Spec that must be brought: a standards body can adopt only what a member writes and must adopt something or lose the field to whoever standardizes without it, so the one member with running code sells the body its own product as the standard, as a vendor's implementation becomes the reference and its patents become essential; the carrier is the charter's deliverable together with the rule that the body writes nothing itself, the seller extracts the reference implementation and a royalty on every conforming device, and the compulsion lapses when a second complete proposal enters the room, which keeps the body's compulsion to adopt and destroys the seller's extraction, or when the market stops waiting for the body at all; not first-mover-forecloses' seizing of the standard, which is a race among rivals, since here the body's own emptiness is what is sold to.

Celibate gate: a gate that outlives its holders must buy every successor from outside, and the purer its rule against reproducing, the more completely it must buy, as the celibate church takes each generation of priests from families that owe it nothing, the partnership must make partners from its associates or die with its founders, and the dynasty without an heir must marry into a house that names its price in provinces; the carrier is mortality plus the succession rule, the seller extracts the successor's terms, the dowry, the partnership share, the package, and the compulsion never lapses but eases to the extent the gate can grow its own, which is why the vow that forbids growing one's own is the pure case; not status-conversions' inheritance, which is what passes to an heir, since here the question is what the gate must pay to have one.

Stamp with an expiry: a gate whose currency is its stamp must spend the stamp on a calendar or the stamp is forgotten, so the annual prize must be given, and publishers time books to the eligibility window and lobby for a strong year to be split; the carrier is the calendar and the memory of the audience, the seller extracts the stamp's full value in a slow year at the price of a strong one, and the compulsion lapses the first time the gate withholds and survives, as the fiction Pulitzer did in 2012, which showed the must to be custom; speculative that the withholding then raises the stamp, since a stamp that can be withheld certifies more than one that cannot; not deal-flow-attractors' name others need, which decays by over-lending, since here the stamp decays by under-lending and the two decays meet at a rate the gate does not know.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: silver purchase acts, airline slots, demurrage, agency nurses, proposed findings of fact, patent continuations, sponsor-run trials, investment periods, papered theatres, appropriations riders, celibate priesthoods, withheld prizes; drawn from law, finance, ports, hospitals, courts, standards bodies, publishing, and churches.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism; one clause in Stamp with an expiry is marked speculative, Crown at the auction keeps the inflation escape conditional, and the cases are illustrations rather than histories.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real gate usually carries several of these compulsions at once (a hospital is a licensed hour, a queue with an exit, and a borrowed eye), and the list claims no coverage.

The seriation is an itinerary of how a compulsion lapses, from repeal to a single survived refusal, and not a ranking of strength, cost, or frequency; map edges are conditional authored claims. The Queue with an exit → Built to be bought loop is authored from the two items' text and has no observed case.

The illustrative cases (the 1893 silver repeal, PURPA contracts, the 2020 slot waiver, the 2013 shutdown, the 2012 Pulitzer, the diesel defeat device, verbatim findings) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.

Ordinary purchases a gate makes because it needs things (paper, power, staff on a Tuesday) are out; only purchases compelled by the gate's position as gate are in, and duties to admit, serve, or deal without purchase (common carriage, universal service, the duty to treat, the essential facility's duty to carry a rival at a tariff, licensing on FRAND terms) are out except where the duty forces a purchase, as in the manned hour; compelled selling is the mirror map this one implies, tollgates that must sell.
Stamp with an expiry's claim that a survived withholding raises the stamp is speculative and marked so; the rest is analytical with observed cases.

seriation.axis: Who holds the clock that compels the gate, and therefore how the compulsion can lapse: from a writ held by a higher gate (lapses only by repeal), through a condition written into the gate's own tenure (lapses at the escape written in), the passers' own clocks (lapses, and inverts, when they can no longer leave), the gate's own calendar priced by the passers (lapses into its taxpayers or its own mint), the gate's procedure and its blindness, the gate's own ledger and format, the gate's franchise and deadline, to the gate's mandate, a mortality held by no one, and finally its habit, where one survived refusal ends it.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary of how compulsions lapse, not a scale of strength or a claim that structural compulsions are stronger than customary ones; the wild priority suspects the customary end has the opposite sign for the gate. Must-take by writ opens it because the gate cannot refuse and only its author can repeal; Stamp with an expiry closes it because the gate can refuse once and find that nothing was holding it. Queue with an exit is the hinge: before it the clock is held by someone else (a legislature, a landlord of seats), after it the clock is the gate's own (its maturity calendar, its license, its docket, its paperwork, its blindness, its fund, its format, its franchise, its mandate, its habit). Crown at the auction sits first after the hinge, on the critic's reading, because its calendar is the sovereign's own while its price is still the dealers', so it is the half-step from a clock the passers hold to a clock the gate holds and the passers price. Celibate gate's clock, mortality, is held by no one, which is why its compulsion is the one that never lapses. Vehicle that must move → Spec that must be brought → Celibate gate → Stamp with an expiry is the consequential stretch: along it the compulsion to buy survives at every step while the seller's extraction is first postponed (the 2013 shutdown showed that what lapses when a customary date is survived is the date, not the eventual purchase), then destroyed by a second proposal while the body's compulsion to adopt remains, then made permanent by a rule against growing one's own, and at the last step revealed to be the whole of the compulsion, so that when the stamp's date is survived nothing is left.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms is a party holding a chokepoint compelled to buy from those who pass it, and which of those compulsions are structural rather than customary?
exploration.changed_question: Who holds the clock that compels the gate, and what of its own must the gate buy from the people it gates? The first breath assumed every compulsion buys a good from a passer and could be sorted into structural and customary; sorting failed (the newspaper's page was physical and lapsed with the medium, the prize's calendar was custom and survived a withholding), and sharpening the port's queue against the hospital's night shift showed that the sort is really about who holds the clock and so how the compulsion can lapse. The second breath then found gates that must buy their own faculties, sight, an answer, a successor, the thing they stamp, from the very parties they gate.
exploration.new_member: Borrowed eyes: a gate that must decide on evidence it cannot make buys its sight from the party it is gating, as the drug regulator judges trials the sponsor designed and ran, the auditor relies on management's representations, and the rating agency rates from the issuer's numbers on the issuer's fee; the carrier is the missing witness architecture, the seller extracts the frame, the endpoints, the comparator, the definition of done, and the compulsion lapses only when someone builds the gate its own eyes, as a university laboratory rather than the regulator caught the diesel defeat device; not capture, which is a purchased gatekeeper, since this gate is honest and blind and buys what it must in order to see at all.

priorities.item: No that must be written: when a gate's refusal requires a written reason and its acceptance requires none, the gate leans toward buying, so the applicant extracts the stamp by exhausting the writer, as patent continuations are refiled until an examiner's rejections cost more than an allowance, while at the consulate, where the refusal needs a sentence and the visa needs a file, the same asymmetry leans the other way; the carrier is the paperwork asymmetry, the seller extracts persistence priced in the examiner's hours, and the compulsion lapses when the gate's own reviewer starts counting bad yeses, as after a recalled drug; not the answer that may not be withheld, which forbids silence and leans neither way, since a jury must return and owes reasons for neither verdict.
priorities.why: It is a property of paperwork rather than of law or money, so it can be read off any gate in an afternoon, and it predicts the direction of the lean at gates the other items only say are compelled.
priorities.next_question: List ten gates you pass this month (an examiner, a consulate, a loan desk, a journal, a zoning board, a cert petition) and for each write down which of yes and no must be accompanied by a written reason; predict the lean before looking, then check the grant rate, and find the one gate where the asymmetry and the lean disagree, since that gate has a second compulsion the paperwork does not show.

priorities.item: Stamp with an expiry: a gate whose currency is its stamp must spend the stamp on a calendar or the stamp is forgotten, so the annual prize must be given, and publishers time books to the eligibility window and lobby for a strong year to be split; the carrier is the calendar and the memory of the audience, the seller extracts the stamp's full value in a slow year at the price of a strong one, and the compulsion lapses the first time the gate withholds and survives, as the fiction Pulitzer did in 2012, which showed the must to be custom; speculative that the withholding then raises the stamp, since a stamp that can be withheld certifies more than one that cannot; not deal-flow-attractors' name others need, which decays by over-lending, since here the stamp decays by under-lending and the two decays meet at a rate the gate does not know.
priorities.why: Low plausibility, high promise: if a survived withholding raises the stamp, then a customary compulsion is not merely weaker than a structural one but has the opposite sign for the gate, and a prize committee that never withholds is spending down a currency it could have minted.
priorities.next_question: Take three prizes that withheld once (the fiction Pulitzer in 2012, the Nobel Peace years, a juried fellowship) and compare submissions and winners' sales in the two years after the withholding with the two years before; then invent a prize that must by rule be withheld one year in five and ask a publisher what a win is worth under that rule compared with the annual one.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after widening the of-sentence to match the map's own boundary claim (four items buy from suppliers who pass no gate), repairing five items (a seller-less case, an inflation promotion, an omitted copy escape, two missing discriminators including the two closest items that never faced each other), and repairing three edge labels whose cases did not demonstrate their antecedents; nothing cut; Crown at the auction reseated first after the hinge and the consequential adjacency rewritten as the critic argued.

neighbors.left: Answer that may not be withheld: a court may not decline to decide a case properly before it, so the litigant who hands it the more adoptable answer sells the court its opinion, as trial judges sign proposed findings of fact verbatim and appellate opinions lift whole paragraphs from the winning brief; the carrier is the prohibition of non liquet together with the docket, the seller extracts the rule in its own words, and the compulsion lapses at the jurisdictional door, since dismissal for want of standing is the one way to answer without buying either story, and it thins toward the top, where a court that may deny review without reasons is under no compulsion at all; not persuasion-moves' shifting of a belief, since the court must take one of the two stories whether or not either persuades.
neighbors.right: No that must be written: when a gate's refusal requires a written reason and its acceptance requires none, the gate leans toward buying, so the applicant extracts the stamp by exhausting the writer, as patent continuations are refiled until an examiner's rejections cost more than an allowance, while at the consulate, where the refusal needs a sentence and the visa needs a file, the same asymmetry leans the other way; the carrier is the paperwork asymmetry, the seller extracts persistence priced in the examiner's hours, and the compulsion lapses when the gate's own reviewer starts counting bad yeses, as after a recalled drug; not the answer that may not be withheld, which forbids silence and leans neither way, since a jury must return and owes reasons for neither verdict.
neighbors.separating_case: A petition for review at a court that may deny it without reasons, beside a patent application at an office where every rejection must be written: both gates are compelled to respond, the first leans no and the second leans yes. The answer that may not be withheld forbids silence and says nothing about direction; the no that must be written decides the direction. A jury shows the first without the second, since it must return and owes reasons for neither verdict, and so leans neither way.

checks.boundary_case: The sole cannery in the valley, which buys the whole tomato crop, is a gate that buys and is out: nothing compels it, the compulsion runs the other way, and the farmers must sell before the fruit rots (market-births' thick before it rots). The same cannery ordered by statute to take every tomato offered at a posted price is in, as Must-take by writ. What separates member from nonmember is not that the gate buys, nor how much, but that the gate's position as gate is what compels the purchase.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: Shelf bought first and Papered house sit as neighbors on the itinerary, but the edge between them says a two-sided gate must buy whichever side the other side reads as evidence, and a gate that buys the invisible side first has bought nothing. It shows a loop, Queue with an exit → Built to be bought → Queue with an exit, authored without an observed case, in which buying the bypass makes the queue captive, the compulsion to clear it lapses into rent, and the longer queue breeds the next bypass. It shows a passage between levels at Vehicle that must move → Hour that must be manned, where a calendar compulsion on the gate arrives at the sellers' level as a market in slots owned by whoever keeps the roster. And it shows two dependencies the line cannot express: Borrowed eyes → No that must be written, where a reasoned refusal must be written in the applicant's own evidence and the lean steepens, and Crown at the auction → Must-take by writ, where the writ at the head of the itinerary is repealed wherever the crown buys money, at the auction or at its redemption window just past the hinge, so the most structural compulsion lapses by way of a compulsion on its author.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context, not a self-read: the strange members (a gate that must buy its own sight, a gate that must buy every successor because it may not breed one, a gate compelled by paperwork rather than by law, a stamp that decays by under-lending) were tested against their nearest neighbors and kept as mechanisms; the repairs restored modality and added discriminators without replacing any mechanism with a more respectable one, and the of-sentence was widened to the boundary the items already obeyed.

name: lead-time-floors
of: A mechanism by which the time it takes for a replacement to arrive draws a person's or a firm's death line above zero, named with the lead time, the carrier that holds it, what shortens it (a finished spare, a pre-started stand, a later stage bought, a pre-signed paper, a side channel, an overlap), what fakes it (a replacement that exists only on paper, a spare never exercised, a stand with a missing cohort), and when its clock can run relative to the source's: ahead and shelved, pre-started in real time, at exercise on another's calendar, only inside the dying runway, or only after the death.
items: Understudy: the replacement is finished before it is needed and waits, as the standby generator, the theatre's understudy, the second goalkeeper, the named successor, the spare transformer in the yard, so the lead time is zero and the floor drops to the wind-down bill alone; the lead time was run to completion in advance, the carrier is an idle copy and its upkeep, it is shortened to nothing at the price of carrying a thing that earns nothing, and it is faked by the spare never exercised, the generator that will not start, the backup never once restored, the understudy who never rehearsed, so the drill and not the spare is the purchase, since a spare's lead time is unknown until it is called; not survival-floors' Kept on call, which is the seller's retainer, since here the operator owns the copy and no other hand can call it.

Longest-lead part: a replacement that must be built has a lead time set by its slowest component rather than by its labour, as the rebuilt substation waiting two years on a transformer, the house after the fire waiting on the permit, the ship on its engine, the clinic on its licensed pharmacist, so the floor is the longest single lead among the parts and the rest of the build hides inside it; the carrier is whichever supplier's or office's queue is longest, it is shortened by stockpiling that one part or holding a pre-approved plan while the labour is engineered down, as Toyota cut a die change from hours to minutes and the inventory that had covered it disappeared, and it is faked by the insurance cheque counted as the house; not Understudy, which is the whole thing finished, since here only the slowest part is bought ahead and the build still runs.

Staggered stand: where the lead time is elapsed time itself, the only purchase is a stand of replacements started at every age, as the forester who plants a cohort every year so a cutting is always ripe, the vintner's barrels of every vintage, the rancher's heifers behind the cows, the firm that is always ramping one hire and the bench of juniors behind a senior; the carrier is the carrying cost of every cohort at once, it is shortened by nothing further, since starting is the whole purchase, and it is faked by the stand with a missing cohort, the hiring freeze that leaves no one to promote ten years later, the forest with no thirty-year-olds, which is invisible until the year the absent cohort would have matured; not Understudy, which is one finished copy, since a stand is bought by starting and not by finishing, and only a stand can replace a replacement.

Gestation: the replacement must grow, as the crop that takes a season, the herd that takes a gestation and a weaning, timber, a barrel's years, an orchard's years before it bears, so the lead time is a count of elapsed time no money converts; the carrier is the thing's own rate of becoming, it is shortened only by buying the thing at a later stage, a heifer rather than a calf, a running business rather than a plan, which is buying someone else's elapsed time, and it is faked by the seed in the ground counted as the crop; not Staggered stand, which is the purchase of starting, since Gestation is the reason the stand is the only purchase, and not Calendar with nothing in it, since here the time is an ingredient and something is growing in it.

Clean months: a replacement that is a standing, a credit line, a licence, a lease, arrives only after the counterparty has watched a required run of periods, as the bank that wants two years of filed accounts, the credit file's seven years after a discharge, the years of residence the state must have seen before citizenship, the reinstatement that wants a clean run since the suspension, the landlord who wants references from the last address; the lead time is the counterparty's evidence rule, the carrier is a record kept in a form the counterparty reads, it is shortened by a guarantor who lends their own record, a co-signer, a vouching institution, and it is faked by the aged shelf company and the borrowed tradeline, which are Gestation's later-stage purchase applied to a record and fail because the counterparty watches the party and not the vehicle and re-attaches its watch on a change of control, so the purchase turns into fraud exactly where it would have worked; adds to who-can-be-bound's time to acquire a hold the guarantor as the purchase; not Gestation, where the thing itself grows and no one need watch, since here a witness must have been kept.

Calendar with nothing in it: the lead time is a wait a rule imposes in which nothing grows and nothing is witnessed, as the year between filing and decree, the interval before a bankrupt may file again, the non-compete's twelve months, the season a suspended driver must sit out; the carrier is the rule and its issuing authority, the wait starts on the operator's own filing or leaving, it is shortened only by a waiver or by a jurisdiction that wrote a shorter one, never by a price, and it is faked by starting under the table, which converts the wait into a risk; not Gestation, where the time is an ingredient, and not Clean months, where the time is evidence, since here the time is the sentence, and the wait's end produces exactly what its start had.

Once a year: the market for the replacement opens on a period longer than many runways, as the academic hiring season, the football transfer window, the visa lottery, open enrolment, the harvest crews, the school year, so the lead time is the distance to the next window plus the window's own processing and the floor is quantized, a day late costing a cycle; the carrier is the window's calendar, which every counterparty shares, so a second counterparty is no shortener and the wait is beaten by nothing but timing the start, and it is faked by the application filed out of window, which is in the pile and in no queue; not Partner meeting, whose calendar is one counterparty's own, so that a second fund's Monday is a shortener and parallel search beats the cadence, since here the calendar is the market's and parallel search beats nothing.

Place in line: the replacement arrives when others leave or when an event no one schedules occurs, as the transplant list, the social-housing list, the visa quota, the berth, so the lead time is a position moved by others' exits or by a priority score and the wait has a distribution and no date; the carrier is the queue's rule of order, it is shortened by a side channel, the living donor, the private lane, or by a rush fee where one is sold, whose existence tells the operator that the wait was a queue and prices the floor, and it is faked by 'on the list' read as a date; not Once a year, where the date is known and the wait is to it, since here the date is unknown and the only knowable thing is the place.

Chain's longest link: the replacement's arrival waits on a chain of other people's replacements, as the housing chain where no one completes until the last buyer's buyer does, the kidney-exchange chain, the transfer that waits on the selling club signing its own replacement, the sublet that waits on the subletter's new lease, so the lead time is the longest path through others' lead times and one link's failure resets the whole; the carrier is the chain's contingency clauses, it is shortened by a chain-breaker, a cash buyer, a bridging loan, an altruistic donor who starts a chain with no link behind, and it is faked by an offer accepted subject to chain; not Place in line, where others' exits move you, since here others' arrivals hold you.

Release at both ends: the replacement has said yes but is held by its own commitments, and the operator is held by theirs, as the hire with three months' notice elsewhere, the tenant with a lease to run, the contractor booked until spring, the player whose club must release, and on the near side the notice the operator must serve; the lead time is the sum of two releases written in contracts with third parties, the carrier is those contracts, it is shortened by buying a release, a transfer fee, a garden-leave buyout, or by drawing from the bench of the uncommitted, and it is faked by the signed offer with no start date; not Partner meeting, where the decision is not yet made, since here the decision is made and the body is not free.

Partner meeting: the replacement arrives on the counterparty's decision calendar rather than the operator's, as the fund's Monday partner meeting, the hiring committee that sits monthly, the credit committee that meets quarterly, the admissions round, the diocese's placement, so the lead time is the cadence of their meetings times the number of gates the decision must pass; the carrier is the counterparty's own process, it is shortened by a pre-signed paper, a standing term sheet, a pre-approved line, an offer held open, whose own fake is that the writer re-decides at exercise, as the credit line reviewed when drawn, and it is faked by the verbal yes, which is a decision not yet on their calendar; adds to runway-illusions' Watched burn, which reprices the terms, the arrival, since a counterparty can be willing and slow.

Ramp inside the floor: the replacement is present but not yet the thing, as the hire's six months to productivity, the new surgeon's first hundred cases, the transplanted kidney's weeks to function, the new supplier's qualification, so the lead time continues past arrival and the floor sits above the start date; the carrier is learning or integration on the operator's own premises, it is shortened by overlap, running the ramp while the old source still works, which costs paying two and requires the old source to host its successor, and it is faked by headcount filled; not Release at both ends, which ends when the body arrives, since here arrival is where the wait begins.

No-shop: the counterparty's paper forbids running the search in parallel, as the term sheet's exclusivity period, the lock-out agreement, the exclusive listing, the visa system that cancels an application when a second is filed, so the lead time becomes serial and each failed candidate costs its whole exclusivity rather than its share of a spread; the carrier is the clause, it is shortened by a short exclusivity or a break fee, and it is faked by the non-binding term sheet whose one binding clause is the no-shop; the exploding offer is the same serialization from the other end, forbidding the wait rather than the search; adds to runway-illusions' Runway in shots, which counts trials, the rule that decides whether trials may run at once.

Seeking is telling: the search for a replacement is visible to the source and shortens it, as the employer who learns of the interviews, the investor who hears the founder pitched the fund next door, the landlord who sees the boxes, the client who learns the firm is prospecting, so a lead time that must be run inside the runway shortens the runway it runs in; the carrier is the source's sight of the search, it is shortened by a discreet channel, the headhunter, the banker's confidential process, the exploratory conversation, and it is faked by the confidential process in a town of one industry; not Watched burn, where the source sees the burn, since here the source sees the cure.

Rising floor: the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, as the unemployed are hired slower than the employed, the firm at three months raises slower than at twelve, the seller with a closing date gets fewer offers, so the floor is not the lead time measured from strength but the fixed point where remaining runway equals the lead time at that remaining runway, and it sits higher; the carrier is the counterparty's reading of the remaining clock as a signal about the operator rather than as a bargaining position, so the field thins, fewer counterparties engage at all and those who do add diligence, and the expected wait lengthens without any price moving; it is shortened by starting from strength, before the clock is legible, and it is faked by the lead time quoted by someone who ran it from strength, since 'it took me six weeks' was measured at another point on the curve; the thinning is observed in labour markets, the fixed point is analytical, and the extension to firms and sellers is by analogy; not Watched burn, which holds the buyer who reads the clock and waits for the price, since here the clock read as a signal removes counterparties rather than moving their terms, and the floor is a fixed point rather than a number.

Starts at the funeral: some lead times cannot begin until the source is dead, as the insurance claim after the fire, the widow's pension after the certificate, the credit that rebuilds only after the discharge, the remarriage after the decree, the acquirer who buys the assets only from the liquidator, so the floor is not above zero but a gap after it and no runway can contain it; the carrier is a rule that makes the death the trigger, it is shortened by a paper filed before, the pre-need contract, the will, the standby letter of credit, the advance directive, whose fake is the paper the trigger itself revokes; the gap is what survival-floors' floors bridge, and this is the map's far edge, where the lead time leaves the runway.

Bridge: a degraded replacement with no lead time exists because the true one has a lead time, as the locum, the temp agency, the bridging loan, the rental car, dialysis, the interim chief, the tarp on the roof, so the purchase is not a shorter wait but a longer survivable one, and the bridge's price is the market's quote of the floor; the carrier is a market in stopgaps priced by the hour, it is shortened by nothing, since it does not shorten, and it is faked by the bridge that becomes the crossing, the temp of nine years, the interim of four; not a survival floor, which holds the operator, since the bridge holds the function at a worse rate, and not Understudy, which is the true thing waiting.

source.register: Concrete and mechanistic: partner meetings, transfer windows, transplant lists, housing chains, notice periods, exclusivity clauses, foresters' cohorts, transformers on order; drawn from finance, employment, property, medicine, manufacturing, forestry, and family law.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Rising floor is observed in labour markets and asserted by analogy elsewhere; Staggered stand's claim that starting is the only purchase for a real-time lead time is speculative and marked so; no item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of hiring, fundraising, or supply chains; a real replacement runs several of these in series (a hire is Partner meeting, then Release at both ends, then Ramp inside the floor), and the list claims no coverage.

The seriation is an itinerary of when the replacement's clock may run relative to the source's, not a ranking of length, cost, or danger; map edges are conditional authored claims, the fixed-point floor is analytical, and the slowdown for the visibly dying is observed for the long-term unemployed and extended to firms and sellers by analogy.

The illustrative cases (two-year transformer leads, housing and kidney-exchange chains, term-sheet exclusivity, the forester's stand of every age, Toyota's die changes, pre-need contracts) are simplified to one mechanism each and are not claims about specific histories, firms, or jurisdictions.

The cost of stopping (the burn that continues through the notice on the operator's own commitments, the wind-down bill) and delays in reaching money already owned belong to runway-illusions; here only the wait for an arrival, which includes the delay the operator's own notice puts on the replacement's start, as Release at both ends admits. The customers' lead time to replace the operator is Too expensive to let die's carrier read from the other side and is out.

Staggered stand's claim holds only where no market in later stages exists; where heifers or running businesses can be bought, the stand is one option among two, and Gestation says which. The operator's own delay in admitting the source is dying was left out as mood rather than mechanism, as runway-illusions also left it.

seriation.axis: When the replacement's clock can run relative to the source's: from lead times run to completion ahead and shelved (a finished spare, a stockpiled slowest part), through lead times pre-started and running in real time whether or not the source fails (a stand of every age, a thing growing, a record being watched), through lead times that run at exercise on someone else's calendar and are indifferent to the source's state (a rule's empty wait, a window, a queue, a chain, a release, a committee), to lead times that can run only inside the dying runway and interact with it (a ramp that needs the old source's hosting, a clause that serializes the search, a search that tells, a floor that rises as it is approached), to the lead times that cannot begin until the death, with the bridge closing as the purchase that lengthens the wait one can survive rather than shortening the wait.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of length or of how often each occurs. Understudy opens it because there the whole lead time was run before the need and nothing is left to wait for; Starts at the funeral sits at the far edge because there no part of the lead time can run before the need, and Bridge closes after it because the bridge is the only purchase that answers a lead time one cannot shorten, by lengthening the wait one can survive instead. The route answers the live question in five grades: what can be bought finished (Understudy, Longest-lead part), what can only be pre-started (Staggered stand, Gestation, Clean months), what runs at exercise on another's clock (Calendar with nothing in it through Partner meeting), what must run inside the dying runway and interacts with the runway it must fit inside (Ramp inside the floor through Rising floor; No-shop changes the search rather than the runway, and belongs here because the search it serializes must fit inside the runway), and what cannot begin until the death. The consequential adjacency is Gestation → Clean months: both are elapsed time, and Gestation's one purchase, buying the thing at a later stage, applied to Clean months' ingredient, a watched record, is the aged shelf company and the borrowed tradeline, a purchase that succeeds where the thing itself is bought and fails where the counterparty's watch re-attaches to the party on change of control, so the same move is a purchase at one item and turns into fraud at the next exactly where it would have worked, and what separates them is whether a witness had to be kept. The hinge is Partner meeting → Ramp inside the floor: the committee is the last lead time that runs entirely on someone else's premises and needs nothing from the old source, and the ramp is the first that runs on the operator's own premises and can be shortened only by asking the old source to host its successor, so from there on every lead time interacts with the runway it must fit inside. Calendar with nothing in it opens the third grade on who starts the clock rather than when it runs: three of its four cases start at the operator's own filing or leaving, and the rule's wait then runs indifferent to the source's state, which is what the grade collects. The second turn is Rising floor → Starts at the funeral: the fixed point is the last lead time that can run before the death and the first item after it cannot start until the death has happened, so the route crosses from a floor above zero to a gap after it. Seeking is telling and Rising floor sit as neighbours because they are the two halves of one loop, and the itinerary can only show them in a row.
