Tolerance: an advantage held in a receiver's naivety is spent by the dose, as the receptor that desensitizes under a repeated agonist so the same dose does less, and the audience that stops flinching at the alarm; the condition spent is the receiver's sensitivity, which becomes tolerance and, when the dose stops, an overshoot in the other direction; it regenerates with abstinence, on the receiver's clock and not the holder's; the mark is the escalating dose, which is the only number the holder can see; not Resistance bred, spent across a population by selection, since here the receiver is one body and the condition comes back if left alone; not stamina, since the thing spent is not the holder's supply but the target's response.

Resistance bred: an advantage over a population is spent by selection, as the antibiotic that leaves the survivors, the pesticide, and the phishing template that survives only in the inboxes trained on it; the condition spent is the population's susceptibility, which becomes a resistant population and a drug moved to the reserve list; it regenerates only where resistance carries a fitness cost and the exercise is withdrawn long enough, and sometimes not at all; the mark is the rising concentration needed for the same effect, measured across the population rather than the patient; the condition is a commons, so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, which is why stewardship is a rule and not a choice; not risk-rebound-effects' The antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk the mitigation breeds, since here the point is the shape of the spend, that the condition is shared and the regeneration is on the pathogen's clock.

Exception cited back: an advantage held in discretion, the power to grant or refuse, is spent by the grant, because the grant is the next petitioner's precedent, as the end-of-quarter discount that teaches the buyer when to buy, the covenant breach waived three times that the borrower pleads as course of dealing, and the exception for one employee that becomes the policy; the condition spent is the unbound choice, which becomes a schedule the counterparty can read; it regenerates only by a distinguishing that costs the holder credibility or by a counterparty who has not seen the record; the mark is the anti-waiver clause, the paper by which lenders try to grant without spending, and the quarter-end spike in bookings; the spend reaches only the counterparty that saw the grant unless a carrier moves the record, a most-favored-nation clause, a union, a reporter; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative, since here the grant reveals nothing and binds by being repeated.

Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.

Slack shown to the budget: an advantage held in a reserve nobody has counted is spent by the first draw on it that a principal sees, as the surge beds staffed on an ordinary Tuesday that appear in next year's bed count, the contingency line spent on the schedule that becomes next year's schedule, the engineer's hidden week of buffer that the manager learns of and removes; the condition spent is the reserve's invisibility, which becomes a line item; it regenerates only by building a new reserve above the new baseline and hiding it better; the mark is the next budget, where the reserve appears as capacity; not Tolerance, spent by a target's adaptation, since here the party that takes the reserve is the holder's own principal, and the exercise is spent not by an adversary but by being seen from above.

Tier above: an advantage held in a signal's rarity is spent by each use, as the priority flag, the urgent subject line, the superlative in the reference letter, and the honorific; the condition spent is the base rate against which the signal is read, which becomes a higher base rate and then decoration; it regenerates only by minting a rank above, the severity zero above the severity one, the new honorific, the word coined to replace the euphemism that has taken on its referent; the mark is the count of tiers, which records how many times the signal has been spent as a tree's rings record winters, an instance of clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Ratchet count; not risk-rebound-effects' The alarm fatigue, the sensitivity raised until the true alarm arrives pre-ignored, since here the spender is each sender and the regeneration is by a new tier that starts rare and is spent the same way.

Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

Loophole with a name: an advantage held in a rule-maker's inattention is spent by exercise at a scale the rule-maker notices, as the tax structure that works until enough firms use it that the rule closing it carries the practice's name, as the anti-Morris-Trust rules carry the structure they ended, and the arbitrage across two regulators closed by a memorandum between them; the condition spent is inattention, which becomes a rule; it regenerates as the next gap, never as this one; the mark is the rule's name, and the practice taught afterward in the course on what used to work; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, where a rival is funded by the margin, since here no one competes for the gap and the responder is the party whose inattention was the condition.

Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: favors never asked, advice-of-counsel waivers, claim-construction orders, chess databases and game film, burned exploits, decrypt cover flights, poker showdowns, torpedo bearings, inspection schedules, receptor desensitization, antibiotic reserve lists, quarter-end discounts and anti-waiver clauses, counteroffers and blocked sales, surge beds and budget lines, severity tiers, order slicing and price impact, rules named after the structures they ended, second sources and generic challengers; drawn from litigation, competitive games, offensive security, wartime intelligence, submarine and sniper doctrine, regulatory inspection, pharmacology, epidemiology, enterprise sales and lending, employment and venture governance, hospital operations, incident management, trading, tax practice, and procurement.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Three items rest on readings the map cannot verify and say so: Never asked (that the first exercise carries almost the whole price regardless of size) is a folk claim stated as a mechanism; Umbrella that funds the entrant (that the incumbent's own margin is what pays for the entrant, rather than the entrant arriving on its own clock) is an analytical reading of price-umbrella cases, and its sanctions clause is speculative; Resistance bred's phishing case is an analogy, and its regeneration claim (a fitness cost of resistance) holds for some resistance genes and not others. The decrypt cover flights in Burned source draw on the documented wartime practice, simplified. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real raise, suit, campaign, or trade spends several of these conditions at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much exercise spends the condition and what must register the exercise, not a ranking of value, danger, or reversibility; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the convergence, passages, fork, and step they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (advice-of-counsel waiver, decrypt cover flights, order slicing, anti-Morris-Trust rules, generic patent challenges, counteroffers) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions, cases, or operations; the exploit and intelligence items describe mechanisms, not practices to adopt.

Spending the advantage's own supply is out: money, stamina, ammunition, a one-use option, since what is consumed is the advantage and not a condition beside it; power-trades' Leased strike, a power spent by disuse, is out by direction, since here the spend is by exercise; and an advantage that becomes unattractive after use, the tactic that now embarrasses, is out unless a condition of its working was consumed. The exhaustion of a right by its first sale, in which the seller is paid and the buyer holds a unit the seller no longer controls, is in type and absent; it would sit beside Sword that drops the shield, spent whole by one exercise the holder priced as a gain.

status-conversions covers what one form of standing converts into and at what rate; power-trades covers what a power fetches when passed to another hand; this map covers only what an exercise consumes on the holder's own side without any conversion or trade, and each item adjacent to those maps says what it adds.

seriation.axis: The smallest exercise that registers, and what must register it for the spend to occur: from an ask of any size that spends the condition whole, registered by the counterparty's memory alone, through exercises spent by a court's ruling, by the record's readers, by the target's forensics, by the counterparty's inference, and by the counterparty's decision to look; then a position spent by any traceable exercise and regenerated by moving; then a series whose pattern spends what no single exercise does; then a body and a population that adapt on their own clocks; then a counterparty, a principal, and an audience whose expectations become the price; and at the end exercises registered by whoever fills or answers them, spent in proportion to their size, or only past a scale that a rule-maker or an entrant can answer.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of value or of danger, read as the smallest exercise that registers: an ask of any size at the start, one exercise in a recording venue or on a logging machine or in an inexplicable act or at a showdown, one traceable act, a series, a dose, a grant, a use, each unit of flow, and at the close an exercise past a scale that wakes a rule-maker or funds an entrant. Never asked opens it because an ask of any size spends the condition whole, and its register is the counterparty's memory alone, as its own turnover clause says, the same register as Lever that tags the hand and Exception cited back; the Fable critic corrected the author's opening claim of 'no register but the holder's own count', which the item's text contradicts. Umbrella that funds the entrant closes it because the register is a party the exercise itself summons, and every exercise below its cost is free forever. Novelty in the book → Zero-day is the consequential adjacency: both are spent by one exercise being read, but the novelty is read by whoever reads the record and the target may never understand it, while the exploit is read by the target's own forensics, so the holder rations one by choosing the venue and the other by choosing the target, and the question a counterparty asks changes from 'was this game published?' to 'does this machine keep logs?'. Zero-day → Burned source moves the register from the target's file system to the target's inference and gives the holder a cover for the first time; Burned source → Image shown down moves the decision to look into the counterparty's hands and gives the holder a fold. Flaming datum → Pattern in the visits is where the walk turns from one exercise to a series: the position regenerated by moving is spent again if the moves make a pattern. Tolerance → Resistance bred is a passage between levels, one body to a population, and the regeneration passes from the receiver's abstinence to the pathogen's fitness cost. Exception cited back, Lever that tags the hand, Slack shown to the budget, and Tier above are spent into expectations, of a counterparty, of a market, of the holder's own principal, of an audience, and the itinerary places the principal among them because the register is the same shape from above as from across. Tier above → Alpha spent by the trade is the hinge: both spend in proportion to use, but the tier's spend is registered in an audience's base rate that must be learned from the record, and the alpha's by whoever fills the order, reading the flow itself, with no record, no forensics, and no cover, so the walk ends where the register is the other side of the book and then where the register is a rule-maker or an entrant that the exercise had to be large enough to wake; the author's 'in the price itself, with no audience' was the same error as the opening and was corrected by the critic. Exception cited back's step edge back to Never asked reveals the two as mirrors, the grantor's and the asker's, registered in the same memory. One dimension the walk does not carry cuts across it: Resistance bred, Tier above, and Loophole with a name all spend a commons, where any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition, and only the first says so.

relations.from: Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.
relations.to: Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.
relations.label: If the exploit is used against a target that keeps no forensics, it is spent only if the effect it produces cannot be otherwise explained, so the zero-day against a blind target is governed by the burned-source rule, and the holder's rationing shifts from choosing targets to choosing cover.

relations.from: Image shown down: an advantage held in a counterparty's model of the holder is spent only if the exercise is revealed, as the tight player's bluff, which wins because of the image and destroys the image at showdown; the condition spent is the model, which becomes its opposite, a loose image that the counterparty can exploit and the holder can exploit in the other direction; it regenerates with a new table, or with time and a run of exercises that confirm the old model; the mark is the calls that come afterward; the holder can fold before the showdown and the counterparty's own fold keeps the image intact, so exercise without spend is available and the spend is made by the counterparty's decision to look; not Zero-day, where the revelation is in the target's hands, since here it is in the holder's hands until the last card.
relations.to: Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.
relations.label: If the exercise is one the counterparty must see in order to be moved by it, as the counteroffer must be shown to the employer, the holder has no fold and the counterparty no choice whether to look, so the image shown down becomes a lever that tags the hand; the fork between them is whether the exercise works unseen.

relations.from: Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate, and the acquirer, who cannot move, regenerates it only by bidding through a hand the market does not yet know is its own; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.
relations.to: Pattern in the visits: an advantage held in the unpredictability of an exercise is spent by no single exercise and by the series, as the surprise inspection that after four Tuesdays is expected on the fifth, the audit whose sampling rule has been inferred, the raid whose timing follows payroll; the condition spent is the target's inability to prepare, which becomes a schedule the target keeps better than the inspector does; it regenerates by randomization, which costs the holder its own planning and its staff's convenience; the mark is the site that is clean on inspection day and not the day after, a pattern the holder can see only by breaking its own; not Novelty in the book, spent by one recorded showing, since here each showing is free and the spend is a property of the sequence.
relations.label: If the regeneration by moving follows a rule the counterparty can infer, the position bought by each move is spent again by the series, and a holder who moves predictably has traded a datum for a pattern.

relations.from: Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.
relations.to: Pattern in the visits: an advantage held in the unpredictability of an exercise is spent by no single exercise and by the series, as the surprise inspection that after four Tuesdays is expected on the fifth, the audit whose sampling rule has been inferred, the raid whose timing follows payroll; the condition spent is the target's inability to prepare, which becomes a schedule the target keeps better than the inspector does; it regenerates by randomization, which costs the holder its own planning and its staff's convenience; the mark is the site that is clean on inspection day and not the day after, a pattern the holder can see only by breaking its own; not Novelty in the book, spent by one recorded showing, since here each showing is free and the spend is a property of the sequence.
relations.label: If the holder slices the order to spend the price's ignorance slowly, the slices make a series, and a counterparty who reads the series takes the rest of the move ahead of the remaining slices, so the rationing that preserves the alpha is what creates the pattern that hands it to a reader; the block spent the condition at once, but into the holder's own fills.

relations.from: Tolerance: an advantage held in a receiver's naivety is spent by the dose, as the receptor that desensitizes under a repeated agonist so the same dose does less, and the audience that stops flinching at the alarm; the condition spent is the receiver's sensitivity, which becomes tolerance and, when the dose stops, an overshoot in the other direction; it regenerates with abstinence, on the receiver's clock and not the holder's; the mark is the escalating dose, which is the only number the holder can see; not Resistance bred, spent across a population by selection, since here the receiver is one body and the condition comes back if left alone; not stamina, since the thing spent is not the holder's supply but the target's response.
relations.to: Resistance bred: an advantage over a population is spent by selection, as the antibiotic that leaves the survivors, the pesticide, and the phishing template that survives only in the inboxes trained on it; the condition spent is the population's susceptibility, which becomes a resistant population and a drug moved to the reserve list; it regenerates only where resistance carries a fitness cost and the exercise is withdrawn long enough, and sometimes not at all; the mark is the rising concentration needed for the same effect, measured across the population rather than the patient; the condition is a commons, so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, which is why stewardship is a rule and not a choice; not risk-rebound-effects' The antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk the mitigation breeds, since here the point is the shape of the spend, that the condition is shared and the regeneration is on the pathogen's clock.
relations.label: If the receiver reproduces under the dose, the spend passes from the body's clock to the population's, abstinence no longer regenerates the condition, and the holder's restraint is worth only what every other holder's restraint is worth.

relations.from: Exception cited back: an advantage held in discretion, the power to grant or refuse, is spent by the grant, because the grant is the next petitioner's precedent, as the end-of-quarter discount that teaches the buyer when to buy, the covenant breach waived three times that the borrower pleads as course of dealing, and the exception for one employee that becomes the policy; the condition spent is the unbound choice, which becomes a schedule the counterparty can read; it regenerates only by a distinguishing that costs the holder credibility or by a counterparty who has not seen the record; the mark is the anti-waiver clause, the paper by which lenders try to grant without spending, and the quarter-end spike in bookings; the spend reaches only the counterparty that saw the grant unless a carrier moves the record, a most-favored-nation clause, a union, a reporter; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative, since here the grant reveals nothing and binds by being repeated.
relations.to: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
relations.label: If the holder has never granted, a refusal is free and reads as the rule, and the first grant spends 'never granted' the way the first ask spends 'never asked', whatever its size; so the decision before any grant is not how much to give but whether to become a party that gives.

relations.from: Ruling that prices the patent: an advantage held in the uncertainty of a right's scope is spent by testing it, as the unlitigated patent that licensees pay to avoid finding out about, and the untested termination clause the counterparty settles rather than construes; the condition spent is the uncertainty, which becomes a claim-construction order or a judgment, and even the win narrows, since a court that upholds a claim says what it covers and every future defendant reads the boundary; it does not regenerate for that right, though a continuation application can grow a new uncertain claim beside it; the mark is the order itself and a licensing rate that steps on the day it issues, up or down; not ghost-leverages' threat of suit under a statute already repealed, a dead power still obeyed, since here the power is live and the exercise reveals its exact size to everyone who will ever face it.
relations.to: Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.
relations.label: If the ruling upholds the claim narrowly, it tells the entrant exactly where the incumbent's price is free to it, so a win that was meant to hold the position draws the line the entrant designs to, and the uncertainty spent in court is the margin the umbrella can no longer keep.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does exercising an advantage consume a condition that made it advantageous, what does the condition become, and does it come back?
exploration.changed_question: What must register the exercise for the condition to be spent, and can the holder ration the spend by choosing the register: is a quiet or a partial exercise available at all? Breath one assumed the counterparty registers the exercise by seeing, reading, inferring, or adapting to it. Pressing on the quarter-end discount showed the register can be the counterparty's expectation rather than its knowledge; pressing on the hidden buffer showed it can be the holder's own principal; and pressing on the informed trade showed an exercise registered by whoever fills it, spent in proportion to its size and by the holder's own wish, which is what made the threshold cases visible, the umbrella and the loophole, where the exercise is free until it is large enough to wake a party that then answers it.
exploration.new_member: Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

priorities.item: Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.
priorities.why: Its carrier is public: brand drug prices, the dates of generic patent challenges, and patent expiries are all recorded, so the claim that the incumbent's own margin is what pays for the entrant, rather than the entrant arriving on the patent's clock, can be checked without anyone's cooperation.
priorities.next_question: For drugs with a single patent family, take the brand's price path in the years before the first generic challenge was filed and compare it with matched drugs that drew no challenge before expiry; if challenges follow price rises past a level rather than tracking expiry alone, the umbrella funded the entrant, and the level at which they arrive is the threshold this item claims.

priorities.item: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
priorities.why: Low confidence that the first exercise carries almost the whole price regardless of its size, since the saying may describe a courtesy rather than a price; high generative promise, because if it holds, a class of advantages is priced by a step at one, and the operator's strategy is to remain a party that has never done the thing, never sued, never discounted, never invoked the clause, until the one exercise that is worth the whole record.
priorities.next_question: In long supplier relationships with recorded requests, compare what a first-ever concession request wins with what the second wins, holding the request's size fixed; the item predicts the first wins more per unit asked and costs more in the price of later requests, and a flat rate across requests would return this item to Introducer's tab's shape and remove it from the map.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the false register claim in Alpha spent by the trade and the edge built on it, completing Flaming datum's regeneration for its market case, and correcting the register reading at both endpoints of the of-sentence and the seriation; no item restated status-conversions or power-trades.

neighbors.left: Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.
neighbors.right: Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.
neighbors.separating_case: One holder uses the same exploit against two targets on the same day. The first target images its disks after every incident, so the exploit is read from the image and patched within the month whether the intrusion took anything or not: spent by use. The second target keeps no logs, and the intrusion's only effect is a file deleted; if the deletion could be a disk failure, the flaw stays unknown and the holder can use it again, and if the deletion is of the one file only the holder wanted, the target infers a channel and hunts for it though it never reads the exploit: spent by inexplicability. A holder who cannot tell which target it faces prices the exploit as spent; one who can chooses the blind target and then spends by cover, which is why the two are one move apart on the map and two stops apart on the walk.

checks.boundary_case: The strike not run in twenty years, which returns at expiry as a threat the employer no longer believes, is a tempting nonmember and is out: it is spent by disuse, and power-trades' Leased strike carries it. Walk on record in walkaway-manufactures is the same power in the other direction, an advantage that regenerates by being exercised, and it too is out. The fence is direction: what exercise consumes is in, what exercise builds or disuse consumes is out. The one-use option, spent by exercise by construction, is out on the other side, since nothing beyond the option's own text is consumed; Never asked is in on exactly that contrast, since the ask is not one-use by any text and the count is a condition the record keeps beside it.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a convergence the walk conceals: Pattern in the visits is one stop on the itinerary, but two rationing strategies drain into it, the relocation that regenerates a Flaming datum and the slicing that spends Alpha slowly, so the two ways a holder has of spending a condition a little at a time are the two ways of making the series that spends it whole. It shows a passage between levels at Tolerance → Resistance bred, where the regeneration passes from the receiver's abstinence to the pathogen's fitness cost and the holder's restraint stops being worth anything alone. It shows a fork at Image shown down, whose two arms are whether the exercise works unseen: if it does the holder keeps a fold, and if the counterparty must see it to be moved the spend is automatic and becomes a Lever that tags the hand. It shows a step at Exception cited back → Never asked, where the first grant is priced like the first ask, so a walk that ends with exercises free below a threshold begins with an exercise for which any size is the threshold. And it shows an inversion at Ruling that prices the patent → Umbrella that funds the entrant, where the win that was meant to hold the position is what tells the entrant where the position ends.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context: each item names a distinct spend, the condition, what it becomes, whether and by what it regenerates, and the mark; the critic tried to collapse Never asked into Exception cited back and could not, since one is the asker's record and the other the grantor's discretion, separated Never asked from Lever that tags the hand on the same raise (a count of restraint against a model of alignment, priced on the holder's next ask against the counterparty's next offer), and kept the strange members (an advantage spent whole by a count going from zero to one, a reserve spent by the holder's own principal seeing it, a win that draws the entrant's line, a spend the holder wants because the spend is the realization) as mechanisms rather than domesticating them into signaling or into cost.

name: learning-that-commits
of: A mechanism by which the act of finding something out changes what the finder can then choose, before the answer can be used, named with the inquiry, the commitment it creates and who bears it, and whether a less committing inquiry exists and what it answers instead, and sorted by where that less committing inquiry lives: in a softer form of the same question, in another asker, in a hypothetical client, in a chosen ear, in a partition of who may know, in a separate team, in a sibling object, in the class instead of the person, in a private form that still lodges in the asked party, in an earlier and worse inquiry, in a purchased interval, in a stop fixed before the trial, in an unwritten reading, in a second question made afterward to cover the first, in a settlement that buys the question back, in a proxy that answers a neighbouring question, nowhere because the clock runs from when the finder should have looked, or nowhere at all, because the question not asked is charged as if it had been answered.
items: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the scoring models' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.

Asking the gatekeeper: the question is put to the party who holds the option, so the asking tells the holder that the option is wanted and the holder reprices it before answering; as the founder who asks her existing investor whether the fund would bridge and learns nothing about the bridge she did not already know but tells the fund the round is not coming, so the bridge, if offered, arrives with terms written for a company that needs it, or the tenant who asks the landlord what breaking the lease would cost and is thereafter a tenant who is leaving, or the buyer whose request for a quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming; the inquiry is the direct ask; the commitment is the holder's updated price, borne by the asker, and it is created by the asking whether or not the answer is yes; the less committing inquiry is one made through a party with no stake, the lawyer who reads the lease for its break clause, the counsel who knows what bridges that fund has done, the question asked about a third company; not Hard pull, where the record of the ask is read by strangers, since here the only reader is the one who holds the answer and the price moves in a single hand; adds to investor-tells' Borrowed eyes the mirror case, the founder's ask read by the investor.

Ruling you can't unask: the authority whose reading of a rule is sought answers on the record, so an adverse answer closes the ambiguity the asker was living in; as the taxpayer who requests a private letter ruling on a structure and, refused, can no longer file it as an honest reading, since the reading was sought and given in writing to this taxpayer and the file now exists, or the exporter who asks customs for a binding classification and is told the higher tariff line and cannot afterward ship under the lower one as a good-faith mistake; the inquiry is the request for the ruling; the commitment is the loss of good-faith ambiguity and the authority's file, borne by the asker; the less committing inquiry is the no-names meeting, in which counsel describes a hypothetical client, and the informal call whose answer binds nobody, each of which carries less weight for the same reason it commits less; not Confidant with a duty, where the asked party's own obligation is triggered by the question, since here the asked party is free and it is the answer that binds; and not Asking the gatekeeper, where the holder reprices what the asker wants, since the authority sells nothing and the price of asking is paid in the asker's later defences.

Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the child who asks the school nurse whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.

Self-inquiry widens the warranty: a party that investigates itself expands what it warrants, because its promises are qualified by what it knows; as the seller whose representations are given 'to the seller's knowledge' and who commissions vendor due diligence before the sale, so that every defect the diligence finds is now a defect the seller knows and warrants against, while the defect it never looked for stays outside the promise; the inquiry is the seller's own diligence; the commitment is the widened warranty, borne by the seller at the indemnity claim; the less committing inquiry is the knowledge group, since the contract defines the seller's knowledge as the actual knowledge of named individuals, and a seller who keeps those individuals out of the diligence sessions can learn and not know, an escape bounded by the buyer's insistence that the group include the people who would know and by any clause that adds what they should have known; not Knowing obliges, where a duty attaches to the finding, since here no duty attaches and what widens is the promise's coverage; and not Tainted by looking, which walls the looker from the thing, since here the wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign.

Tainted by looking: seeing the thing forecloses building it independently, because the look can never afterward be unproven; as the acquirer whose engineers read the target's code in diligence and who, if the deal fails, cannot build a rival module without facing the claim that they copied, so the look removed the build option that existed before it; the inquiry is the technical diligence; the commitment is contamination, borne by the looker in every later dispute, and created the moment the look occurs, before any answer is drawn from it; the less committing inquiry is the clean room, a separate team that never looks and is shown only a specification, or the third-party auditor who examines the code and reports pass or fail without content, each of which answers a narrower question so that the wide one stays askable; the residuals clause, which licenses what the looker's engineers happen to remember, is the negotiated price of looking without a room; not deal-deaths' Paid in the tasting, where the look supplies enough of the good that the deal is not needed, since here the look removes the looker's own alternative.

Breaking to know: the inquiry consumes the object it was to decide about, so the answer arrives for a thing that is gone and the decision moves to its siblings; as the weld sectioned to learn its penetration, the lot of cartridges proof-fired to learn its pressure, the bottle opened to learn whether the vintage has kept, so what is learned is about the batch and the choice 'use this one' is spent by the asking; the inquiry is the destructive test; the commitment is the loss of the specimen and the inference from sibling to sibling, borne by whoever must now trust that the untested ones are alike; the less committing inquiry is the non-destructive one, ultrasound or radiography for the weld, a proof load below failure for the beam, which answers about this object and worse, and consumes a little of it anyway, since a proof load spends fatigue life; not witness-architectures' Half kept back, which reserves a duplicate so the reading's error leaves a trace, since here the concern is not the record of the reading but that the thing decided about is what the reading destroyed.

Question plants itself: asking a party what it would do installs in that party a decision it was not facing, so the answer describes a party the question has changed; as the manager who asks the engineer whether she is thinking of leaving, and converts an unexamined staying into a staying that has now been chosen or not, or the spouse who asks whether the other would stay if the money ran out; the inquiry is the direct question to the subject; the commitment is that the subject now holds the option as an option, borne by the asker, who has lost the choice of keeping her by inertia and must now keep her by a decision she is also making, and who cannot again have the subject who had not thought of it; the less committing inquiry is to ask the class rather than the person, the anonymous engagement survey, or to watch rather than ask, calendar gaps and recruiter mail, each of which answers about a population or a posture and not about her; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party prices something the asker wants, since here nothing is priced and what changes is which futures the asked party can see; speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured.

Bear hug that puts them in play: the question changes the asked party's obligations and the asker's retreat at once, because some parties cannot receive a question without a process; as the acquirer who writes to a public target's board proposing to buy it at a price, so that the board, which could have declined a private call with a shrug, must now consider the proposal under its duties, may have to disclose it, and, once it decides to sell, may be obliged to seek the best price rather than this one, while the acquirer, once the letter is known, cannot withdraw without being read as having found something or been refused; the inquiry is the written offer; the commitment is the process the board must run and the asker's loss of an unwatched exit, borne by both; the less committing inquiry is the private, non-binding indication of interest, which triggers no process and which the target's counsel reads for whether it is really private; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, an attack on the responder's options, since here the asker wanted an answer and got a process; not Question plants itself, where what lodges in the asked party is a thought, since here what lodges is a duty; the duties named are a simplified reading of one jurisdiction's public-company law.

Answer only inside the incision: the answer of the grade needed exists only in a state that itself demands a decision, so the deciding must happen on a provisional answer within a window the inquiry opened; as the surgeon who sends a frozen section from the operating table and gets a preliminary read while the patient is open, so that resect or close must be chosen in the anesthesia window on the fast read, since the permanent pathology arrives in days and the patient cannot be held open for it; the inquiry is the opening itself, with the sample sent from inside it, since the sample alone makes no window; the commitment is the decision made in the window on the lesser answer, borne by the patient, and the window is made by the inquiry itself; the less committing inquiry is the preoperative biopsy, which answers earlier and about less, since the margin and the node become questions only once the specimen is out, and which in some tumours carries its own commitment through seeding along the needle track, so the earlier question is not free; not Breaking to know, where the specimen is consumed and the decision moves to its siblings, since here the patient is whole and the decision is moved into the window.

Fuse shorter than the finding: the inquiry takes longer than the option lives, so finding out first is a way of letting the option expire; as the buyer whose structural survey needs three weeks against an offer that must be accepted by Friday, the employer whose reference checks outlast the candidate's competing offer, the investor whose diligence outlasts the expiry a rival wrote on its term sheet; the inquiry is any that needs the calendar; the commitment is the option's death during the finding, borne by the finder, who learns the answer to a question that no longer has a choice attached; the less committing inquiry is the purchased interval, the option fee, the earnest money at risk, the exclusivity bought with a break fee, the inspection period written into the contract, so that 'find out first' is available at a price and the price is the market's measure of what the finding commits; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, where the counterparty's paper serialises the search, since here nothing forbids the parallel and the calendar alone closes it; not runway-illusions' Runway in shots, which counts the trials a runway holds, since here the runway is the option's and not the finder's.

Pilot that grandfathers itself: a trial run to find out whether a thing works becomes the default while it runs, so the answer arrives to a party for whom stopping is now a change; as the contractor brought in to see how it goes who after a year is the person the team cannot lose, the pilot with a customer whose integration is built during the pilot so that not renewing is a churn, the prototype that ships because it works, the trial separation that installs two households; the inquiry is the trial; the commitment is the moved status quo, borne by whoever must now act to end what began as a look; the less committing inquiry is the trial with its end fixed at the start, a date, a decision rule written before the data, a pilot built on plumbing meant to be thrown away, and each of these is faked often enough that a counterparty reads whether the end is real; not deal-deaths' Ghost closing, where a deal is lived before it is signed and loses its urgency, since there the parties wanted the deal and here they wanted to know; adds to risk-rebound-effects' The hardened patch the case where the thing that ossified was an experiment.

Knowing obliges: a duty attaches to the finding, so the learner who finds cannot afterward choose to have not found; as the manufacturer whose engineers test a fielded part and find a failure mode, and who now must recall or notify rather than decide whether to, the seller who tests the well and must disclose the result to every buyer, the radiologist who orders the scan for one thing and must report the nodule found for another; the inquiry is the test; the commitment is the duty, borne by the learner, and it is created by the answer's existence rather than its use; the less committing inquiry is the unrecorded reading, the consultant asked to say it aloud and not write it, the sample kept off the books, each of which is a hazard of its own since the law often treats the oral finding as known; not deal-deaths' Report that must be acted on, where the written record obliges the buyer's lender or board, since here the duty is the finder's own and needs no third party to read it.

Use that burns the source: the answer can be used only in ways that do not reveal how it was obtained, so a class of actions is removed from the learner at the moment of learning; as the reader of an adversary's ciphers who cannot act on every decrypt without telling the adversary the cipher is read, and so must let some convoys sail, or the bidder who learns a seller's reserve from a leak and cannot bid exactly at it without exposing the leak; the inquiry is the covert channel; the commitment is that every act on the answer must be plausibly sourced elsewhere, borne by the learner as a constraint on all later moves; the less committing inquiry is made afterward and is a second question whose only purpose is to be the visible source of the first's answer, the reconnaissance flight sent to 'find' the convoy already located, the case rebuilt in the open from a tip, so the covert inquiry costs a second, overt one; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asking discloses need, since here the asking discloses nothing and the using does; the cipher case is the documented Second World War practice of protecting decrypts, simplified.

Known only by staking it: the answer can be had only by putting at risk the thing whose value the answer decides, so the inquiry is a wager on the asset; as the patent whose validity is known only by asserting it, since assertion invites the invalidity challenge that, lost, ends the patent everywhere, so a weak patent is worth most unasserted and its holder cannot learn its strength without spending it, or the form contract whose enforceability is known only by suing on it, where a loss binds every copy in the book; the inquiry is the assertion; the commitment is the asset staked, borne by the holder, and the answer, if adverse, is the asset's end; the less committing inquiry is the settlement before judgment, which buys the question back at a price and with a record that tells the next challenger the holder feared the answer, and the private opinion of counsel, which answers only the holder; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, the attacker's move, since here the holder wants to know and the knowing costs the thing; adds to deal-deaths' Price found too precisely the case where what is found too precisely is the asset's own strength.

Only the real thing answers: the answer is defined as the act's outcome, so any inquiry short of the act answers a neighbouring question and the act cannot be tried; as the device whose yield is known by detonation, which spends the device and the treaty, the backup whose restorability is known by restoring, the evacuation plan known by evacuating, the ally known to come by the war; the inquiry is the act; the commitment is total and coincides with the answer, borne by whoever the act commits; the less committing inquiry is the proxy, the simulation, the tabletop, the subcritical test, the restore to a spare machine, each of which answers about the model and not the thing, and the distance between them is where the surprise lives; not Pilot that grandfathers itself, where the trial becomes the thing by running, since here the trial was the thing from the first; and not Breaking to know, which spends a specimen to learn about its siblings, since here there are no siblings and the thing learned about is the thing spent.

Finding starts the fuse: the finding starts a clock the learner did not choose, so the choice the answer bears on begins to expire from the moment it is known or should have been; as the owner who discovers the foundation crack and thereby starts the limitations period against the builder, the insured whose claims-made policy requires notice as soon as practicable after the insured knows, the company whose determination that a breach is material starts the days it has to file; the inquiry is any that finds; the commitment is the fuse, borne by the learner, who now has a dated period in which 'decide afterward' must occur; the less committing inquiry does not exist by design, since the discovery rule runs from when a reasonable party would have discovered, so not looking does not stop the clock, only hides its reading; not runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission that expires on a date no cash extends, since here the date is set by the finding and not by the calendar; and not Knowing obliges, where the finding removes a choice, since here it dates one.

Blindness priced as knowledge: the question not asked is charged as if answered, so the escape of not finding out commits as the finding would; as the purchaser who can claim the innocent-landowner defence to a contamination liability only by having made all appropriate inquiries before buying, so that not inspecting is not innocence but the loss of the defence, the buyer under caveat emptor who could have inspected and cannot later rescind, the officer whose deliberate avoidance of a fact is treated by the court as knowledge of it; the inquiry is the one refused; the commitment is imputed knowledge, borne by the refuser, with none of knowledge's uses; the less committing inquiry is the inquiry of exactly the required depth and no deeper, the site assessment that satisfies the standard without the sampling that would find the thing, and the law sets that depth for the purpose; not Knowing obliges, where the finding creates the duty, since here the not-finding does; not Finding starts the fuse, which dates a choice from when the finder should have looked, since here the whole defence is lost and no clock is offered; the doctrines named are simplified from one jurisdiction's environmental and criminal law.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: credit pulls and rate-shopping windows, bridge asks, letter rulings, board members and auditors, knowledge groups, code-room diligence and residuals clauses, sectioned welds and proof loads, stay questions, bear-hug letters, frozen sections, survey clocks against offer deadlines, contractors who become staff, recalls and incidental findings, discovery rules and claims-made notice, protected decrypts, patent assertion, detonation and restore drills, the innocent-landowner defence; drawn from lending, venture rounds, tax and customs practice, corporate boards, acquisitions, engineering test, employment, surgery, real estate, insurance, litigation, signals intelligence, and weapons and operations testing.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Question plants itself is marked speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured. Needle-track seeding is documented for some tumours and its frequency varies. The legal doctrines (letter rulings, knowledge qualifiers, board duties on receipt of an offer, discovery rules, all-appropriate-inquiries, wilful blindness) are one jurisdiction's, simplified. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; Fable critic (fresh context) review applied 2026-09-10
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real diligence, a real hire, a real surgery runs several of these at once, often with one inquiry falling under three of them, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of where the less committing inquiry lives, not a ranking of how much each inquiry commits or how often the escape works; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, incompatibility, dependency, and passages they draw are interpretations; the edge from Bear hug that puts them in play to Question plants itself inherits its target's speculative modality, and the priorities entry carries its test.

The illustrative cases (credit inquiries and rate-shopping windows, private letter rulings and binding classifications, knowledge qualifiers and knowledge groups, clean rooms and residuals clauses, frozen sections and needle-track seeding, bear-hug letters and board duties, discovery rules and claims-made notice, decrypt protection, patent assertion, the innocent-landowner defence) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; the legal doctrines are one jurisdiction's, vary, and are not advice.

The answer that changes what the finder wants (the buyer who learns of the mould and no longer wants the house) is out, since the choice set is intact and only the valuation moved; the inquiry that merely costs money is out, since an expense is not a commitment unless it changes what can be chosen; the inquiry that leaves a trace nobody reads is out; what is in is the inquiry that itself removes, dates, prices, relocates, or imputes a choice, whether to the asker, the asked, or a third ear.

option-expiries covers options that lapse without their holder declining; Fuse shorter than the finding is in here only because the inquiry is what does the expiring. advantages-spent-by-use covers an advantage consumed by exercise; Known only by staking it borders it and is in here because the spending is the price of the answer, not of the use. The inquiry that commits a third party who never asked, the sibling whose genetic result answers for the sibling who chose not to know, is in type and absent; it would sit beside Breaking to know, with the family as the batch.

seriation.axis: Where the less committing inquiry lives: from a softer form of the same question, through another asker, a hypothetical client, a chosen ear, a partition of who may know inside one party, a wall between the looker and the thing, a sibling object, the class instead of the person, a private form that still lodges in the asked party, an earlier and worse inquiry, a purchased interval, a stop fixed before the trial, an unwritten reading, a second question made afterward to cover the first, a settlement that buys the question back, a proxy that answers a neighbouring question, nowhere because the clock runs from when the finder should have looked, to nowhere at all, where the question not asked is charged as if answered.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of how much is committed. Hard pull opens it because its escape is the cheapest and is supplied by the same institution that made the question committing, a softer form of the same question; Blindness priced as knowledge closes it because there the escape of not asking is itself charged, so the walk ends where the type's own question, whether 'find out first' is available, is answered no in both directions. Asking the gatekeeper -> Ruling you can't unask -> Confidant with a duty is the first consequential run: the asked party goes from one who prices what you want, to one whose answer binds you, to one whose duty is triggered by your question, so the asker's escape moves from an intermediary to a hypothetical to a choice of ear. Self-inquiry widens the warranty -> Tainted by looking is the hinge of the middle: both escapes partition who may know, but the warranty's wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign, and the clean room's wall runs between the looker and the thing, so a general counsel who has built a knowledge group already knows how to build a clean room and may not know she does. Question plants itself -> Bear hug that puts them in play is where the commitment crosses to the asked party, a thought and then a duty. Answer only inside the incision -> Fuse shorter than the finding -> Pilot that grandfathers itself are the three escapes that live in time, earlier, bought, and pre-fixed. Knowing obliges -> Use that burns the source is where the escape passes from an unwritten reading to a second question written afterward to cover the first; Use that burns the source and Known only by staking it are the two escapes made afterward, a cover question and a settlement; Only the real thing answers is the proxy that answers a neighbour; Finding starts the fuse stands past the proxy because there the escape is nowhere, since the clock runs from when the finder should have looked; and Blindness priced as knowledge closes because it is not that no escape exists but that the escape is charged. Finding starts the fuse and Blindness priced as knowledge are the same doctrine seen from two ends, constructive discovery, and the walk sets them side by side and separates them by what is lost, a dated choice against a whole defence; the Fable critic argued this placement so that the walk reaches nowhere once and does not come back.

relations.from: Asking the gatekeeper: the question is put to the party who holds the option, so the asking tells the holder that the option is wanted and the holder reprices it before answering; as the founder who asks her existing investor whether the fund would bridge and learns nothing about the bridge she did not already know but tells the fund the round is not coming, so the bridge, if offered, arrives with terms written for a company that needs it, or the tenant who asks the landlord what breaking the lease would cost and is thereafter a tenant who is leaving, or the buyer whose request for a quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming; the inquiry is the direct ask; the commitment is the holder's updated price, borne by the asker, and it is created by the asking whether or not the answer is yes; the less committing inquiry is one made through a party with no stake, the lawyer who reads the lease for its break clause, the counsel who knows what bridges that fund has done, the question asked about a third company; not Hard pull, where the record of the ask is read by strangers, since here the only reader is the one who holds the answer and the price moves in a single hand; adds to investor-tells' Borrowed eyes the mirror case, the founder's ask read by the investor.
relations.to: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the scoring models' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.
relations.label: If the gatekeeper asked keeps a record that other gatekeepers read, as a lender's pull is filed at the bureau and a fund's pass is told to the next fund over lunch, the disclosure of need to one hand becomes a count of asks read by every hand, so a question that would have moved one price moves all of them, and the asker's escape must change from an intermediary to a softer question; where the gatekeeper keeps no shared record, the intermediary suffices.

relations.from: Self-inquiry widens the warranty: a party that investigates itself expands what it warrants, because its promises are qualified by what it knows; as the seller whose representations are given 'to the seller's knowledge' and who commissions vendor due diligence before the sale, so that every defect the diligence finds is now a defect the seller knows and warrants against, while the defect it never looked for stays outside the promise; the inquiry is the seller's own diligence; the commitment is the widened warranty, borne by the seller at the indemnity claim; the less committing inquiry is the knowledge group, since the contract defines the seller's knowledge as the actual knowledge of named individuals, and a seller who keeps those individuals out of the diligence sessions can learn and not know, an escape bounded by the buyer's insistence that the group include the people who would know and by any clause that adds what they should have known; not Knowing obliges, where a duty attaches to the finding, since here no duty attaches and what widens is the promise's coverage; and not Tainted by looking, which walls the looker from the thing, since here the wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign.
relations.to: Blindness priced as knowledge: the question not asked is charged as if answered, so the escape of not finding out commits as the finding would; as the purchaser who can claim the innocent-landowner defence to a contamination liability only by having made all appropriate inquiries before buying, so that not inspecting is not innocence but the loss of the defence, the buyer under caveat emptor who could have inspected and cannot later rescind, the officer whose deliberate avoidance of a fact is treated by the court as knowledge of it; the inquiry is the one refused; the commitment is imputed knowledge, borne by the refuser, with none of knowledge's uses; the less committing inquiry is the inquiry of exactly the required depth and no deeper, the site assessment that satisfies the standard without the sampling that would find the thing, and the law sets that depth for the purpose; not Knowing obliges, where the finding creates the duty, since here the not-finding does; not Finding starts the fuse, which dates a choice from when the finder should have looked, since here the whole defence is lost and no clock is offered; the doctrines named are simplified from one jurisdiction's environmental and criminal law.
relations.label: If the law or the contract charges the seller with what its people should have known, the knowledge group that lets a seller learn without knowing is closed, since the individuals kept out of the room are charged with what the room found, and Blindness priced as knowledge runs in the same clause; where knowledge is defined as the actual knowledge of named persons and nothing is imputed, the knowledge group stands and not looking is not charged; so the escape from the warranty and the charge for not looking are never both live under one definition of knowledge, and a seller offered the one should expect to be spared the other.

relations.from: Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the child who asks the school nurse whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.

relations.label: If the ear chosen carries a duty to act on what it hears, the asker's question becomes a finding in a second body and Knowing obliges runs there, out of the asker's hands, so the asker who wanted to decide afterward has delegated the deciding to the confidant's duty; the same question in the lawyer's ear stays a question.
